text: Living the Mizmor

The “Living the Mizmor” section is intended primarily for the benefit of people who recite Tehillim on a regular basis, but who sometimes have difficulty knowing what thought (kavanah) they should have in mind as they say each posuk. Also, some people would like help in relating the text to specific needs in their own life.

To help overcome this challenge, we have identified certain categories of meaning and then explained how each relevant posuk fits into a particular category. We start with three very broad categories: Torah, Tefillos, and Tehillos.

In preparing these analytic interpretations we have not attempted to identify every possible kavanah, only some of those that seem especially significant. Also, you will find that any one posuk can fit easily into more than one category. Of course, all possible meanings are relevant, but time and space restrictions prevent us from attempting to document every one.

TORAH. The Torah category is used for those pesukim that can be understood as teaching you the will of Hashem in regard to your behavior or your attitude (thoughts). When you come across one of these pesukim it would be helpful for you to stop and think about how this lesson might affect your life.
Lessons For Life
Your Behavior – Tehillim gives you specific guidelines for what to do and how to do it.
Your Attitude – Tehillim gives you advice on what your attitude should be when you are thinking about the major issues in your life.

TEFILLOS. The Tefillos category is used for those pesukim that serve primarily as the basis for a tefillah (prayer) to Hashem. Such a prayer might be a bakashah (request) for a specific form of Hashem’s kindness in the future. Alternately, a posuk in the Tefillos category might be an expression of personal gratitude for a specific form of kindness that Hashem has shown you in the past. It might also be an expression of your present relationship with Hashem (how you feel towards Him). We will try to show how the posuk you are saying expresses one of these kinds of meaning.
Tefillos For Life
Your Gratitude – Tehillim gives you many pesukim with which you might express your gratitude to Hashem for specific kindnesses.
Your Relationship – These are pesukim in which you can focus on your relationship with Hashem.
Your Anguish – These are pesukim in which you can contemplate the meaning of suffering or difficulties that you may be experiencing.
Your Teshuvah (Repentance) – These are pesukim in which you can express your guilt and regret for sins that you may have committed. And you can ask Hashem to forgive you and cleanse your soul.
Your Requests – These are pesukim with which you might be expressing a plea to Hashem for a specific need.
Berachah (Blessing) – Ask Hashem to bless you with such kindnesses as health, livelihood, and children.
Refuah (Healing) – Ask Hashem to grant you relief from physical ailments.
Yeshuah (Deliverance) – Ask Hashem to overcome threats and persection, to protect you from harm, and to defeat your enemies.
Geulah (Redemption) – Ask Hashem to bring the time of universal peace and recognition of the One G-d, heralded by the Mashiach.

TEHILLOS. The Tehillos category is used for those pesukim that serve primarily as the basis for a tehillah (praise) to Hashem. They are, in effect, your expressed recognition of Hashem’s qualities and attributes as perceived by mankind. By intelligently reciting such pesukim you are intensifying your emunah (faith) in His eternal truth and your bitachon (trust) in His future actions toward you and the world.
Tehillos For Life
Contemplation of Hashem – Think and speak about about the infinite wisdom and kindness of Hashem, as seen in the wonders of Creation and taught in the Torah.

Public Acclaim – Join others in publicly acknowledging and praising the greatness of Hashem. When people offer public recognition of Hashem they inspire each other and strengthen their emunah. They are also contributing to the important goal of universal recognition of Hashem.

1.title: The Message of the Torah
1.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your gratitude and devotion to Hashem.

items.title: SEEK FULFILLMENT
items.he: אַשְׁרֵי הָאִישׁ
items.quote: Fortunate is the man.
items.text: Seek your fulfillment in life through activities that ennoble you spiritually. These are the activities that make you an “ish” (the highest form of human being) rather than those that degrade you, like building wealth for its own sake or achieving power over others.

items.title: AVOID RISK OF SIN
items.he: וּבְדֶרֶךְ חַטָּאִים לֹא עָמָד
items.quote: who has not spent time on the path of sinful people.
items.text: Avoid situations in which you are vulnerable to sinful behavior, even if it is unintentional or inadvertent.

items.title: AVOID IDLENESS
items.he: וּבְמוֹשַׁב לֵצִים לֹא יָשָׁב
items.quote: who has not sat in the gatherings of scoffers.
items.text: Don’t expend your valuable time in idle conversation, mockery, and sarcasm.

items.title: LEARN TORAH
items.he: בְּתוֹרַת ה’ חֶפְצוֹ
items.quote: Rather his only desire is for Hashem’s Torah.
items.text: Devote yourself to the wisdom of Torah, not only to learn it but to make the Torah part of you.

items.raw: [1:1] BASIC NEEDS. – אַשְׁרֵי הָאִישׁ “Fortunate is the man.” [1:3] – וְהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַל פַּלְגֵי מָיִם – “He is like a tree that has been planted beside streams of water.” Ask Hashem for sustenance, health and happiness.

items.title: SUCCESS
items.he: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה יַצְלִיחַ
items.quote: everything that he does is successful.
items.text: Ask Hashem for success in your endeavors and initiatives.

items.title: CHILDREN
items.he: אֲשֶׁר פִּרְיוֹ יִתֵּן בְּעִתּוֹ
items.quote: which yields its fruit in due season.
items.text: Ask Hashem for the blessing of good and healthy children to follow in your footsteps.

items.title: VERDICT IN JUDGMENT
items.he: כִּי יוֹדֵעַ ה’ דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים
items.quote: for Hashem knows the way of the tzaddikim.
items.text: Ask Hashem to be counted among the tzaddikim and not among the resha’im so that your destiny will be that of the tzaddikim.

items.title: OPEN UP
items.he: כִּי יוֹדֵעַ ה’ דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים
items.quote: for Hashem knows the way of the tzaddikim.
items.text: Open yourself up to Hashem. Let Him in to your heart, so that He can actively know you.

2.title: Defending the Kingdom
2.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing devotion to Hashem.

items.title: TOTAL DEPENDENCE
items.he: בְּנִי אַתָּה אֲנִי הַיּוֹם יְלִדְתִּיךָ
items.quote: You are My son. I have begotten you today.
items.text: Think of yourself as a newborn baby who is entirely dependent on the mother who has given birth to him and for whom he has done nothing. She is happy with him because of her quality of chesed (lovingkindness) and his potential for the future.

items.title: YIRAH
items.he: עִבְדוּ אֶת ה’ בְּיִרְאָה וְגִילוּ בִּרְעָדָה
items.quote: Serve Hashem in awe and rejoice, but do it with trembling.
items.text: When you experience great joy, such as in making a simchah, don’t lose your sense of yiras Hashem (the fear of Hashem), that is, “rejoice … with trembling.”

items.title: DAVID’S DYNASTY
items.he: וַאֲנִי נָסַכְתִּי מַלְכִּי עַל צִיּוֹן הַר קָדְשִׁי
items.quote: I Myself have anointed My king upon Tzion, My holy mountain.
items.text: When you say the blessing “Es Tzemach David” in the daily Shemoneh Esrei have in mind that you are earnestly asking for the final Geulah (Redemption) and that this depends on the restoration of David’s dynasty to rule over Yisrael in the same spirit with which David composed Tehillim.

items.title: CONFLICT
items.he: תְּרֹעֵם בְּשֵׁבֶט בַּרְזֶל
items.quote: You will smash them with an iron sword.
items.text: If you are facing a military conflict, plead with Hashem to help you by vanquishing your enemies.

3.title: A Father’s Anguish
3.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your gratitude and devotion to Hashem.

items.title: EMOTIONAL PAIN
items.he: ה’ מָה רַבּוּ צָרָי
items.quote: Hashem, how many are my tormentors!
items.text: – When misfortune strikes, don’t deny the pain you are experiencing. Accept it as the will of Hashem, knowing that even pain is good, for there is a plan and purpose behind it.

items.title: INSULTED
items.he: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים לְנַפְשִׁי אֵין יְשׁוּעָתָה לּוֹ בֵאלֹקִים
items.quote: Many are saying of my soul, ‘There is no salvation for him from G-d.’
items.text: When you are disappointed by the lack of respect or consideration that other people show towards you, turn to Hashem and put your trust in Him. You can be sure that He knows your true value as a human being and loves you.

items.he: וְאַתָּה ה’ מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי
items.quote: But You Hashem are a shield for me.

items.title: RELEASE FROM PAIN
items.he: קוֹלִי אֶל ה’ אֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲנֵנִי מֵהַר קָדְשׁוֹ
items.quote: [With] my voice I call out to Hashem and He answers me from Tzion, His holy mountain.
items.text: When you experience emotional pain, use your voice to call upon Hashem and He will comfort you.

items.raw: [3:6] SLEEP. אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי ה’ יִסְמְכֵנִי – “I lay down and slept; I awoke [with confidence] for Hashem sustains me.” If you have problems sleeping, plead with Hashem to help you so that you will wake up refreshed.

items.title: SLEEP
items.he: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי ה’ יִסְמְכֵנִי
items.quote: I lay down and slept; I awoke [with confidence] for Hashem sustains me.
items.text: If you have slept well, thank Hashem for helping you wake up refreshed.

items.title: PROTECTION
items.he: כִּי הִכִּיתָ אֶת כָּל אֹיְבַי לֶחִי, שִׁנֵּי רְשָׁעִים שִׁבַּרְתָּ
items.quote: For You strike all my enemies on the cheek; You smash the teeth of the resha’im.
items.text: Thank Hashem for the occasions when He restrained those who wanted to harm you.

items.title: DANGER
items.he: לֹא אִירָא מֵרִבְבוֹת עָם
items.quote: I will not fear the tens of thousands of people.
items.text: Even if you are surrounded by danger don’t be afraid for Hashem is always with you.

items.title: WELFARE OF OTHERS
items.he: לַה’ הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶךָ
items.quote: The yeshuah is Hashem’s, Your blessing is on Your nation.
items.text: When you ask Hashem for a yeshuah, have in mind other Jews.

4.title: Loyalty and Commitment
4.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your gratitude and devotion to Hashem.

items.title: MAKING A REQUEST
items.he: בַּצָּר הִרְחַבְתָּ לִּי חָנֵּנִי
items.quote: You relieved me in distress. Be kind to me.
items.text: When you ask Hashem for something, first express your gratitude for His past kindnesses. Don’t frame your request as something you deserve or that He owes you. Rather ask Him to do it as an act of pure kindness and graciousness

items.title: ASKING A FAVOR
items.he: קָרְאִי עֲנֵנִי אֱלֹקֵי צִדְקִי
items.quote: When I call out, answer me, my G-d of benevolence. You relieved me in distress. Be kind to me and hear my tefillah.
items.text: If you want to ask a favor from someone, don’t start right in with your request. First, address the person courteously and make sure he is ready to give you his attention. Let him know you will appreciate anything he will do for you. This is especially important when the individual is someone to whom you owe respect.

items.title: ADMONISHING
items.he: בְּנֵי אִישׁ
items.quote: Sons of man.
items.text: When admonishing or rebuking someone, speak to him with respect, indicating that what he is doing is unworthy of him.

items.title: MAINTAINING SILENCE
items.he: תֶּאֱהָבוּן רִיק תְּבַקְשׁוּ כָזָב
items.quote: [How long] will you love empty talk, seeking falsehood?
items.text: Avoid empty talk, treachery, and falsehood. Be silent when you are tempted to utter sinful talk.

items.raw: [4:5] וְדֹמּוּ — “Be silent.”

items.title: INTROSPECTION
items.he: אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַל מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם
items.quote: Consider in your hearts, lying in bed.
items.text: Before falling asleep at night, make an effort to think through your actions of the day to see if you have behaved badly.

items.title: CHASIDUS
items.he: הִפְלָה ה’ חָסִיד לוֹ
items.quote: Hashem has set apart a devout person to be His.
items.text: Develop an attitude of chasidus (being devout), that is, going beyond what is strictly required. Only then can you expect Hashem to be forgiving in His attitude towards you.

items.title: TREMBLING
items.he: רִגְזוּ וְאַל תֶּחֱטָאוּ
items.quote: Tremble and don’t sin.
items.text: Develop an attitude in which you tremble in fear of behaving badly and angering Hashem.

items.title: SINCERITY
items.he: זִבְחוּ זִבְחֵי צֶדֶק
items.quote: Offer sacrifices of righteousness.
items.text: When correcting your behavior, think of it as a sacrificial offering that you are making to Hashem. Be sincere about your devotion and your motives.

items.title: ENVY
items.he: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים מִי יַרְאֵנוּ טוֹב
items.quote: Many say, ‘Who will show us the good?
items.text: Don’t be envious of the good fortune of others. Hashem gives you what is appropriate for you and that may be different from the person you are envying.

items.title: GOOD WILL
items.he: נָתַתָּה שִׂמְחָה בְלִבִּי מֵעֵת דְּגָנָם וְתִירוֹשָׁם רָבּוּ
items.quote: You have put gladness in my heart from the time their grain and wine abound.
items.text: Be happy for the good fortune of another. Your positive attitude is an expression of your love for the other person.

items.title: RESENTMENT
items.he: בְּשָׁלוֹם יַחְדָּו אֶשְׁכְּבָה וְאִישָׁן
items.quote: At peace, I will simultaneously lie down and fall asleep.
items.text: Don’t harbor resentment towards someone who has harmed you. Look to his doing teshuvah and being forgiven. Your goal should be a unity in peace.

5.title: Surrounded by Enemies
5.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your gratitude and devotion to Hashem.

items.title: OPEN UP
items.he: אֲמָרַי הַאֲזִינָה ה’ בִּינָה הֲגִיגִי
items.quote: Hashem, listen to my words, understand my thoughts.
items.text: Ask Hashem to look into your thoughts. See also Mizmor 001, Lessons for Life – Your Attitude.

items.title: ONE TO ONE
items.he: מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹקָי
items.quote: My King and my G-d.
items.text: Even though Hashem has a relationship with every being that He created, His relationship with each one is unique. So appeal to Him as a unique individual — “my King” and “my G-d”. At the same time have in mind that you are counting on Him alone: “for to You do I pray.” There is no other being that can help you. Any other intermediary is acting under His direction.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.he: ה’ נְחֵנִי בְצִדְקָתֶךָ
items.quote: Hashem, guide me in Your righteous [ways].
items.text: Ask Hashem to give you guidance so that you will not err in doing His will.

items.title: NAME OF HASHEM
items.he: וְיַעְלְצוּ בְךָ אֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ
items.quote: Those who love Your Name will exult in You.
items.text: Pay special attention when you speak of His Name. Through His Name you are being connected to eternity, the infinite past and the infinite future.

items.title: MORNING
items.he: ה’ בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי
items.quote: Hashem, You will hear my voice in the morning.
items.text: Let your first tefillos of the day be as early in the morning as possible. In this way you are demonstrating your priorities in life.

items.title: ABODE OF HASHEM
items.he: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ
items.quote: As for me, through Your great kindness, I enter Your house.
items.text: Seek to spend as much time as you can in the place where Hashem’s presence is most intense, the place that has been identified as His abode, e.g. a place of Torah learning and/or communal tefillah. When you enter His abode, have in mind that it is a great privilege, which you are being granted through Hashem’s “great kindness.”

items.title: EVIL EYE
items.he: ה’ נְחֵנִי בְצִדְקָתֶךָ לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי
items.quote: Hashem, guide me in Your righteous [ways] because of my watchful enemies.
items.text: Be aware that you may be the target of “watchful enemies,” that is, people who look at you with envy and resentment. Protect yourself by making sure to have a good attitude towards the blessings that Hashem showers on others.

items.title: DEFAMATION
items.he: קֶבֶר פָּתוּחַ גְּרוֹנָם
items.quote: Their throat is an open grave.
items.text: When someone opens his mouth to spread gossip or slander, visualize that mouth as an open grave.

items.title: WORRY
items.he: כִּי אַתָּה תְּבָרֵךְ צַדִּיק ה’ כַּצִּנָּה רָצוֹן תַּעְטְרֶנּוּ
items.quote: For You, Hashem, will bless the righteous man, enveloping him with reassurance like a shield.
items.text: Don’t give in to fear and worry of what misfortune might happen to you. If you are a servant of Hashem, He will envelope you with protection like a shield that surrounds you.

items.title: SELF-DESTRUCTION
items.he: הַאֲשִׁימֵם אֱלֹקִים יִפְּלוּ מִמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם
items.quote: Let them fall by their own designs.
items.text: Ask that people who want to harm you should be disabled through their own actions, without the need for your active involvement.

6.title: A Plea for Healing
6.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your gratitude and devotion to Hashem.

items.title: ANGER
items.he: ה' אַל בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וְאַל בַּחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי
items.quote: Hashem, do not rebuke me in Your anger. Do not chastise me in Your rage.
items.text: When you admonish a child or student to behave properly in the future you should speak compassionately, and not with open anger. When you rebuke the child or student for past behavior, it is appropriate to show visible anger, but there should never be an element of suppressed bitter anger or hatred.

items.title: INTROSPECTION
items.he: ה' אַל בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי
items.quote: Hashem, don’t rebuke me in Your anger.
items.text: If you are suffering illness or pain, search your heart and ask yourself what sin you might have committed to warrant the anger of Hashem.

items.title: OPTIMISM
items.he: שָׁמַע ה' קוֹל בִּכְיִי
items.quote: Hashem has heard the sound of my weeping.
items.text: After praying for recovery, be optimistic that Hashem has heard you and your recovery will surely take place in the near future.

items.title: FORGIVENESS
items.he: כָּל אֹיְבָי יָשֻׁבוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ רָגַע
items.quote: When all my enemies return, they will be ashamed for a while.
items.text: Even though you have been wronged, once your adversaries see the error of their ways, be ready to forgive them. Let their shame be only “for a while”.

items.title: KINDNESS
items.he: חָנֵּנִי ה'
items.quote: Grant me Your mercy, Hashem.
items.text: When you ask Hashem for something, don’t frame your request as something you deserve or that He owes you. Rather ask Him to do it as an act of pure kindness. See also Mizmor 004, Tefillos for Life – Your Relationship with Hashem.

items.title: ENOUGH
items.he: חָנֵּנִי ה' כִּי אֻמְלַל אָנִי
items.quote: Grant me Your mercy, Hashem, for I have been cut down.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to call an end to your suffering for its purpose has been served. You have learned a painful lesson and have resolved to change your ways.

items.title: HEALING
items.he: רְפָאֵנִי ה'
items.quote: Heal me, Hashem.
items.text: This tefillah is especially appropriate for anyone who needs a refuah (recovery) from illness. A person can feel this need for himself, for loved ones, or for the community as a whole.

items.title: ILLNESS
items.he: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד
items.quote: My soul is utterly terrified.
items.text: If you are suffering illness or pain, ask Hashem to soften the blow so that your life is not placed in jeopardy.

items.title: LIFE
items.he: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁאוֹל מִי יוֹדֶה לָּךְ
items.quote: For there is no mention of You in death. In the grave who will thank You?
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant you life for you will be unable to do mitzvos after death.

items.title: PAIN
items.he: יָגַעְתִּי בְּאַנְחָתִי
items.quote: I am exhausted from groaning.
items.text: Ask Hashem to ease your pain for then your spirits will rise and you will be better able to serve Him.

7.title: Shigayon – A Song of Errors
7.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah to Hashem.

items.title: RELY ON HASHEM
items.he: ה’ אֱלֹקַי בְּךָ חָסִיתִי
items.quote: Hashem, my G-d, I have sought refuge with You.
items.text: If you rely only on Hashem alone, He will answer your tefillos.

items.title: TURNING TO INTERMEDIARIES
items.he: בְּךָ חָסִיתִי
items.quote: I have sought refuge with You.
items.text: Don’t turn to intermediaries, for your help is from Him alone.

items.title: INTROSPECTION
items.he: אִם עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת אִם יֶשׁ עָוֶל בְּכַפָּי
items.quote: If I have done this, if there is injustice in my hands.
items.text: Examine your inner thoughts to question your motives and your actions. Don’t automatically assume that you are justified in everything you did. See also Mizmor 004.

items.title: VANQUISH ENEMIES
items.he: הִנָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְרוֹת צוֹרְרָי
items.quote: Raise Yourself because of the excessive rage of my tormentors.
items.text: If you are contending with a bitter enemy, ask Hashem to help you by vanquishing them. See also Mizmor 002.

items.title: JUDGE ACCORDING TO MERITS
items.he: שָׁפְטֵנִי ה’ כְּצִדְקִי וּכְתֻמִּי עָלָי
items.quote: Judge me, Hashem, according to my righteousness and my underlying sincerity.
items.text: Ask Hashem to look at your good deeds and at your faults when judging you.

items.title: VANQUISH ENEMY BY SELF-DESTRUCTION
items.he: יִגְמָר נָא רַע רְשָׁעִים
items.quote: Let the evil of the wicked finish [them].
items.text: Ask that people who want to harm you should be disabled through their own actions, without the need for your active involvement.

items.title: OPEN UP
items.he: וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת וּכְלָיוֹת אֱלֹקִים צַדִּיק
items.quote: searcher of hearts and minds, righteous G-d of judgment.
items.text: Open yourself up to Hashem. Let Him in to your heart, so that He can actively know you.

items.title: DEFEAT OF ENEMIES
items.he: בּוֹר כָּרָה וַיַּחְפְּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל בְּשַׁחַת יִפְעָל
items.quote: He has dug a pit. He has dug it deep; he will fall into the deep pit which he has made.
items.text: Don’t give in to fear and worry of what your enemies might do to you. Hashem will arrange for their self-destruction.

items.title: DEFEAT OF THE WICKED
items.he: אוֹדֶה ה’ כְּצִדְקוֹ
items.quote: I thank Hashem according to His righteousness.
items.text: Thank Hashem for protecting you by defeating the wicked.

items.title: SUPERIOR TO ALL
items.he: וַאֲזַמְּרָה שֵׁם ה’ עֶלְיוֹן
items.quote: I sing praises to Hashem’s Name, Most High.
items.text: Praise Hashem as being superior to all powers.

8.title: The Splendor of the Universe
8.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as tefillos expressing your gratitude to Hashem and as tehillos expressing your recognition of Hashem.

items.title: SOURCE OF ALL EXISTENCE
items.he: ה’ אֲדֹנֵינוּ
items.quote: Hashem, our L-rd.
items.text: His Name of four letters signifies that He is the source of all existence.

items.title: BEYOND EARTHLY UNDERSTANDING
items.he: מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ
items.quote: Hashem, our L-rd, How majestic is Your Name throughout the earth.
items.text: His majesty is beyond the ability of earthly creatures to appreciate or comprehend.

items.title: VASTNESS OF THE HEAVENS
items.he: תְּנָה הוֹדְךָ עַל הַשָּׁמָיִם
items.quote: You placed Your majesty in the heavens.
items.text: His majesty is revealed in the awesome splendor of the moon and the stars.

items.title: HUMILITY AND WISDOM
items.he: מִפִּי עוֹלְלִים וְיֹנְקִים יִסַּדְתָּ עֹז
items.quote: Out of the mouth of young children and infants You have established strength.
items.text: He shows His humility by revealing His power and His wisdom in the tiniest beings.

items.title: MINDFUL OF MAN
items.he: מָה אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי תִזְכְּרֶנּוּ
items.quote: What is man, that You are mindful of him
items.text: Despite the vastness of the universe, Hashem has given man a central role, only a little less in status than the angels.

items.title: DOMINION TO MAN
items.he: תַּמְשִׁילֵהוּ
items.quote: You have given him dominion
items.text: Man has been given dominion over all Hashem’s creatures, acting as the steward of Hashem on earth.

9.title: Against the Odds
9.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your gratitude and devotion to Hashem.

items.title: NO INTERMEDIARY
items.he: אֶשְׂמְחָה וְאֶעֶלְצָה בָךְ
items.quote: I will rejoice and exult in You.
items.text: Strengthen your relationship with Hashem by realizing that it was He who helped you and not any apparent intermediary.

items.title: NAME OF HASHEM
items.he: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ
items.quote: Those who know Your Name will trust in You.
items.text: Through His Name you are assured of His continuity throughout eternity, which means He is able to keep His promise. See also, Mizmor 005.

items.title: SO MANY THINGS
items.he: אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ
items.quote: I will proclaim all of Your wondrous deeds.
items.text: Have in mind all the other occasions when you were helped and all the daily miracles you experience.

items.title: UNCONDITIONAL GRATITUDE
items.he: אוֹדֶה ה’ בְּכָל לִבִּי
items.quote: I will thank [You] Hashem with all my heart.
items.text: Your gratitude for Hashem’s mercy should not be dependent on His doing more kindnesses in the future.

items.title: MY CAUSE
items.he: עָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִי וְדִינִי
items.quote: You carried out my judgment and my cause.
items.text: I did not even have to fight my enemy for You took up my cause.

items.title: SHARE YOUR KNOWLEDGE
items.he: אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ
items.quote: I will proclaim all of Your wondrous deeds.
items.text: Share your experiences and your knowledge of Him with others.

items.he: הַגִּידוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו
items.quote: Proclaim His deeds among nations.

items.raw: [9:3] SING IN PRAISE. אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן – “I will sing praise to Your Name, Most High.” Inspire others through song.

items.he: זַמְּרוּ לַה’
items.quote: Sing in praise to Hashem.

items.title: POWER IN WAR
items.he: בְּשׁוּב אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר יִכָּשְׁלוּ וְיֹאבְדוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ
items.quote: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish from Your presence.
items.text: Hashem instills fear in the hearts of the enemy.

items.title: RIGHTEOUS JUDGE
items.he: יָשַׁבְתָּ לְכִסֵּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶדֶק
items.quote: You sat on [Your] throne, O righteous Judge.
items.text: You determine if the righteous person is worthy of a miracle being done on his behalf. But all men are judged based on the rule of law.

items.he: וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים
items.quote: He judges the world with righteousness. He judges the nations in fairness.

items.title: VENGEFUL JUDGE
items.he: גָּעַרְתָּ גוֹיִם אִבַּדְתָּ רָשָׁע
items.quote: You rebuked peoples and You doomed the rasha.
items.text: You execute strict judgment agains the wicked.

items.title: ETERNAL JUDGE
items.he: ה’ לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב כּוֹנֵן לַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹ
items.quote: Hashem is enthroned forever. He has established His throne for justice.
items.text: The past and future are always before Him.

items.title: DEFENDER OF THE WEAK
items.he: וִיהִי ה’ מִשְׂגָּב לַדָּךְ
items.quote: Hashem will be a tower of strength for the downtrodden.
items.text: He defends Yisrael and if Yisrael is victimized by evil people, He comes to their aid and avenges them.

items.he: כִּי דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר לֹא שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עֲנָוִים
items.quote: For He Who avenges the blood of the many peoples that were victimized by oppressors has remembered them.

items.title: FAITHFUL TO HIS PEOPLE
items.he: לֹא עָזַבְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁיךָ
items.quote: You do not forsake those who seek You.
items.text: Those who turn to Hashem in tefillah are assured of His response.

10.title: When Evil Prospers
10.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: ARROGANCE
items.he: בְּגַאֲוַת רָשָׁע יִדְלַק עָנִי
items.quote: In the arrogance of the rasha he hunts down the poor.
items.text: Take special care to avoid arrogance, which is the attitude of the wicked. Because of it they feel free to victimize innocent people.

items.raw: [10:4] HASHEM IS ALWAYS THERE. – אֵין אֱלֹקִים כָּל מְזִמּוֹתָיו – “There is no G-d” [is the basis of] all his scheming.” Don’t fall into the trap of the wicked who disregard the presence of Hashem when they wish to do what they know He abhors.

items.title: PROSPERITY OF THE WICKED
items.he: יָחִילוּ דְרָכָיו בְּכָל עֵת
items.quote: His ways are always successful.
items.text: Don’t let yourself be misled or demoralized by the apparent success of the wicked, no matter how convincing it looks. They succeed because they are not restrained by conscience or morality, but they will pay a heavy price for their crimes.

items.title: DISTANCE
items.he: לָמָה ה’ תַּעֲמֹד בְּרָחוֹק
items.quote: Why, Hashem do You stand at a distance?
items.text: Plead with Hashem not to remain distant from you, especially if you are in trouble and are desperate for His help.

items.title: URGENCY
items.he: קוּמָה ה’, אֵ־ל נְשָׂא יָדֶךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּח עֲנָוִים
items.quote: Arise, Hashem. G-d, lift Your hand, don’t forget the humble.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to act immediately to bring the yeshuah for which you have been praying so long.

items.title: SELF-DESTRUCTION OF THE WICKED
items.he: יִתָּפְשׂוּ בִּמְזִמּוֹת זוּ חָשָׁבוּ
items.quote: May [the resha’im] be caught in the very schemes they have contrived.
items.text: Ask that people who want to harm you be disabled through their own actions, without the need for your active involvement.

items.title: DISABLING THE WICKED
items.he: שְׁבֹר זְרוֹעַ רָשָׁע
items.quote: Break the power of the rasha.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to bring the evil power of resha’im to an end so that their victims are freed from their cruelty.

items.he: בַּל יוֹסִיף עוֹד לַעֲרֹץ אֱנוֹשׁ מִן הָאָרֶץ
items.quote: [The rasha] will no longer continue to terrorize any earthly mortal.

items.title: ETERNITY
items.he: ה’ מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם וָעֶד
items.quote: Hashem is King eternally.
items.text: Hashem rules the world for all time and any appearance of imbalance in the scheme of things will ultimately be resolved.

11.title: Chizuk for a Fugitive
11.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: COURAGE
items.he: בַּה’ חָסִיתִי אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי נוּדִי הַרְכֶם צִפּוֹר
items.quote: I have taken my refuge in Hashem. How dare you say to me, flee from your mountain like a bird?
items.text: If you trust in Hashem’s protection, you can confidently challenge anyone who seeks to weaken your relationship with Him.

items.title: HASHEM IS RIGHTEOUS
items.he: כִּי הַשָּׁתוֹת יֵהָרֵסוּן צַדִּיק מַה פָּעָל
items.quote: When the foundations of the world are destroyed, what has [Hashem] the tzadik done?
items.text: Don’t let yourself be demoralized by tragedy. Hashem is righteous and always acts with righteousness, even though His purpose may not yet be clear to us. To be righteous means to do what is “right.”

items.title: METHODICAL PROCEDURES
items.he: כִּי הִנֵּה הָרְשָׁעִים יִדְרְכוּן קֶשֶׁת כּוֹנְנוּ חִצָּם עַל יֶתֶר לִירוֹת בְּמוֹ אֹפֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵב
items.quote: For behold, the wicked stretch the bow, ready their arrow on the bowstring to shoot in the dark at the upright of heart.
items.text: Don’t get caught up in the mechanics of preparation while ignoring the ultimate result of your activities.

items.title: THE OMNISCIENT ONE
items.he: עֵינָיו יֶחֱזוּ עַפְעַפָּיו יִבְחֲנוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם
items.quote: His eyes observe. His eyelids [are open to] scrutinize mankind.
items.text: Hashem sees all, and there is no evil that escapes Him.

items.title: THE TEST
items.he: ה’ צַדִּיק יִבְחָן
items.quote: Hashem tests the tzadik.
items.text: The success of the wicked is an exercise in the emunah of the tzadik. Ultimately, the tzadik is strengthened by it.

items.title: JUSTICE
items.he: יַמְטֵר עַל רְשָׁעִים פַּחִים
items.quote: He will rain down fiery coals upon the resha’im.
items.text: Ultimately, the resha’im must pay for their crimes, unless they have repented.

items.title: HEAVENLY REWARD
items.he: צְדָקוֹת אָהֵב יָשָׁר יֶחֱזוּ פָנֵימוֹ
items.quote: He loves righteousness, for the upright to see His presence.
items.text: Because Hashem is righteous He continues to purify those who are upright until they merit to see His presence.

12.title: Against Hypocrisy
12.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: RELIANCE
items.he: הוֹשִׁיעָה ה’ כִּי גָמַר חָסִיד כִּי פַסּוּ אֱמוּנִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָם
items.quote: Save [me], Hashem for there is no longer any devout man. For truthful people have disappeared from among men.
items.text: People I rely on may disappoint me, no matter how upright they appear to be. Therefore I will place my total bitachon in You alone. My guiding principle is to please You and do what is right.

items.title: FALSEHOOD
items.he: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לִלְשֹׁנֵנוּ נַגְבִּיר
items.quote: [May Hashem cut down] those who have said, ‘By means of our tongues we will prevail!’
items.text: Base your relationships on truth, not on falsehood and deception.

items.title: BASENESS
items.he: כְּרֻם זֻלּוּת לִבְנֵי אָדָם
items.quote: When baseness is exalted among the sons of men.
items.text: Don’t succumb to prevailing practices of falsehood and hypocrisy in business and the professions. Just because others are doing it doesn’t make it right.

items.title: DELIVERANCE
items.he: עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר ה’ אָשִׁית בְּיֵשַׁע יָפִיחַ לוֹ
items.quote: Hashem will say, ‘I will now rise up, I will grant a deliverance [to save each one from the resha’im] who set a trap for him.’
items.text: Turn to Hashem to save those who have been victimized by the reshai’im of the world.”

items.title: TRUTH
items.he: אִמֲרוֹת ה’ אֲמָרוֹת טְהֹרוֹת כֶּסֶף צָרוּף
items.quote: For the words of Hashem are pure words, like refined silver.
items.text: The words of the Torah that Hashem has given to mankind are absolutely reliable because they come from the Source of truth. Their purity is made all the more evident in comparison with the falsehood and hypocrisy that characterizes men.

13.title: How Long Must I Wait?
13.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for relief from your troubles and expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: HIS CONCEALMENT
items.he: עַד אָנָה תַּסְתִּיר אֶת פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי
items.quote: How long will You conceal Your presence from me?
items.text: Plead with Hashem to end this period of His concealment and bring the long-awaited Ge’ulah (Redemption) for all of Klal Yisrael.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: וַאֲנִי בְּחַסְדְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי
items.quote: But as for me, I trust in Your kindness.
items.text: Declare with total sincerity your trust and confidence in Hashem’s kindness. Because of it He will surely bring the Ge’ulah.”

items.title: HOW LONG
items.he: עַד אָנָה אָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשִׁי יָגוֹן בִּלְבָבִי יוֹמָם
items.quote: How long must I devise strategies for the anguish in my heart throughout the day?
items.text: Plead with Hashem to end this period of anguish which overwhelms you so that it never leaves your mind, even when you are busy with your affairs.”

items.title: ANTICIPATED JOY
items.he: יָגֵל לִבִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ
items.quote: My heart will rejoice in Your deliverance.
items.text: Anticipate the joy and the gratitude you will feel when Hashem grants you a yeshuah from your troubles.”

items.title: LIFE
items.he: הַבִּיטָה עֲנֵנִי ה’ אֱלֹקָי הָאִירָה עֵינַי פֶּן אִישַׁן הַמָּוֶת
items.quote: Enlighten my eyes lest I sleep [the sleep of] death.
items.text: Plead with Hashem not to bring your life to an end for there is much you need to do to fulfill your mission in His service.

14.title: Exposing Evil
14.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: GUARD YOUR HEART
items.he: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹקִים, הִשְׁחִיתוּ הִתְעִיבוּ עֲלִילָה אֵין עֹשֵׂה טוֹב
items.quote: The villainous fool says in his heart, ‘There is no G-d.’ They have acted corruptly and committed despicable acts. There is not one who does good.
items.text: It is not enough to behave properly. You must have a good attitude and emunah in Hashem; otherwise you will be like the villainous fool.

items.title: ANTICIPATED JOY
items.he: בְּשׁוּב ה’ שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל
items.quote: When Hashem restores the exiles of His people, Yaakov will exult, Yisrael will rejoice.
items.text: Have bitachon in the favorable outcome that Hashem has promised to those who are faithful to Him.

items.title: STRENGTH OF CHARACTER
items.he: הַכֹּל סָר יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה טוֹב אֵין גַּם אֶחָד
items.quote: But all have turned away. They have gone foul together. There is no doer of good; there is not even one.
items.text: When your generation is being tested, stand up for what you believe in and do the right thing, even if it means going against everyone else.

15.title: Who is Worthy?
15.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: A PLEA FOR GUIDANCE
items.he: ה’ מִי יָגוּר בְּאָהֳלֶךָ
items.quote: Hashem, who is worthy of being in Your tent?
items.text: Ask Hashem to guide you in doing what is needed to please Him and maintain an ongoing closeness with Him.

items.raw: [15:2] SINCERITY. – הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים – “[1] He walks in perfect innocence. Observe the mitzvos of Hashem whole-heartedly and sincerely, without consciously interpreting their meaning to suit your convenience.

items.title: FAIRNESS
items.he: וּפֹעֵל צֶדֶק
items.quote: [2] He does what is right.
items.text: Act charitably toward your fellow man and make sure not to cause him harm or pain.

items.title: TRUTH
items.he: וְדֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ
items.quote: [3] He speaks the truth in his heart.
items.text: Let your spoken words conform to what is in your heart.”

items.title: NO GOSSIP
items.he: לֹא רָגַל עַל לְשֹׁנוֹ
items.quote: [4] He has no gossip on his tongue.
items.text: Don’t reveal private information, even if true, and even if seemingly innocent.”

items.title: NO HARM
items.he: לֹא עָשָׂה לְרֵעֵהוּ רָעָה
items.quote: [5] He does no harm to his fellow.
items.text: Avoid actions that cause financial or emotional harm to others.”

items.title: NO INSULT
items.he: וְחֶרְפָּה לֹא נָשָׂא עַל קְרֹבוֹ
items.quote: [6] He does not embarrass his close relative.
items.text: Don’t insult another person or embarrass him in any way. Treat him as though he were your close relative, with whom you want to maintain a long-lasting friendly relationship.”

items.title: NO FLATTERING
items.he: נִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס
items.quote: [7] In his eyes, a person who is contemptible [because of his sins], is repulsive.
items.text: Don’t flatter a sinful person, even if he is rich and powerful.”

items.title: RESPECT
items.he: וְאֶת יִרְאֵי ה’ יְכַבֵּד
items.quote: [8] He honors those who fear Hashem.
items.text: Be respectful towards individuals who are occupied with learning Torah and doing good deeds.”

items.title: STAY COMMITTED
items.he: נִשְׁבַּע לְהָרַע וְלֹא יָמִר
items.quote: [9] He takes an oath to his own [physical] detriment and he does not retract it.
items.text: If you make a vow to desist from a material pleasure, don’t weaken your commitment.”

items.title: NO INTEREST
items.he: כַּסְפּוֹ לֹא נָתַן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ
items.quote: [10] He does not lend his money at interest.
items.text: If you lend someone money, don’t charge him interest.”

items.title: NO BRIBES
items.he: וְשֹׁחַד עַל נָקִי לֹא לָקָח
items.quote: [11] He does not take a bribe to favor an innocent [party].
items.text: If you have the duty of judging a situation don’t accept a bribe of any kind, even if you are convinced it will not affect your judgement.

16.title: The Way to Life
16.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: DIVINE PROTECTION
items.he: שָׁמְרֵנִי אֵ־ל כִּי חָסִיתִי בָךְ
items.quote: Protect me O G-d, for I have taken refuge with You.
items.text: Ask Hashem to protect you from danger for you are depending on no one but Him.

items.title: MY MASTER
items.he: אָמַרְתְּ לַה’ אֲדֹ־נָי אָתָּה טוֹבָתִי בַּל עָלֶיךָ
items.quote: [O my soul,] say to Hashem, You are my Master. My good is not on You [to provide].
items.text: Acknowledge Hashem as the Master of your life, for you owe Him your very existence and there is nothing that He owes you.

items.title: CONTINUAL PRESENCE
items.he: שִׁוִּיתִי ה’ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד
items.quote: I constantly set Hashem before me.
items.text: Acknowledge Hashem’s constant presence throughout your life. He guides you, sustains you, and protects you.

items.title: DIVINE GUIDANCE
items.he: תּוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים
items.quote: Teach me the way to true life.
items.text: Ask Hashem to maintain His continual presence with you and to guide you in making the right choices in life so that you will ultimately be deserving of eternal life.

items.title: THE HOLY ONES
items.he: לִקְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בָּאָרֶץ הֵמָּה וְאַדִּירֵי כָּל חֶפְצִי בָם
items.quote: [It is] for the sake of the holy ones who are in the earth and [Your] mighty ones [who fear You]. Because of them all my wishes have been granted.
items.text: Acknowledge your personal debt of gratitude to your holy ancestors and to the living tzadikim of your generation. It is because of their merit that Hashem has granted you life.

items.title: COMPLETE DEVOTION
items.he: ה’ מְנָת חֶלְקִי וְכוֹסִי אַתָּה תּוֹמִיךְ גּוֹרָלִי
items.quote: Hashem, [You are] my allotted portion and my share. You have determined my destiny.
items.text: Declare your devotion to Hashem. He is the Author of your destiny your mission in life.

items.title: THE SWEETEST
items.he: אַף נַחֲלָת שָׁפְרָה עָלָי
items.quote: My inheritance is beautiful to me.
items.text: Thank Hashem and express your appreciation for the circumstances of life that He has granted you. You did nothing to earn your life.

items.title: COUNSEL
items.he: אֲבָרֵךְ אֶת ה’ אֲשֶׁר יְעָצָנִי
items.quote: I bless Hashem for counseling me.
items.text: Thank Hashem for the guidance He is providing to you, transmitted from those around you and from within your own body.

items.raw: [16:4] BAD INFLUENCES. – יִרְבּוּ עַצְּבוֹתָם אַחֵר מָהָרוּ – “Let their sorrows abound, [those] who hurry after other gods. Avoid emulating people who have committed themselves to false ideals and false powers.

items.title: CONTINUAL JOY
items.he: לָכֵן שָׂמַח לִבִּי וַיָּגֶל כְּבוֹדִי
items.quote: Therefore, my heart rejoices and my soul is elated.
items.text: The knowledge of Hashem’s presence and kindness to you should invoke a state of continual gratitude and joy.

items.title: ETERNAL LIFE
items.he: כִּי לֹא תַעֲזֹב נַפְשִׁי לִשְׁאוֹל
items.quote: For You will not leave my soul in the grave.
items.text: Your joy should be enhanced by the expectation of eternal life.

17.title: Hear My Thoughts
17.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: SINCERITY
items.he: הַקְשִׁיבָה רִנָּתִי, הַאֲזִינָה תְפִלָּתִי בְּלֹא שִׂפְתֵי מִרְמָה
items.quote: Hashem, hear [my] sincere [thoughts]; be attentive to my song; listen to my tefillah [that is] not from lips of deception.
items.text: Be honest and sincere whenever you speak, but especially when addressing Hashem. If you are not totally open with Him, he knows it.

items.raw: [17:2] עֵינֶיךָ תֶּחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים – “Your eyes see uprightness.”
[17:3] צְרַפְתַּנִי בַל תִּמְצָא, זַמֹּתִי בַּל יַעֲבָר פִּי – “You have tested me and found no [hypocrisy]; my thoughts did not contradict the words of my mouth.”

items.title: CONFIDENCE
items.he: אֲנִי קְרָאתִיךָ כִי תַעֲנֵנִי אֵ־ל
items.quote: I call to You because You will answer me.
items.text: If you have done teshuvah, be confident in approaching Hashem to hear your tefillos.

items.title: ETERNAL LIFE
items.he: אֲנִי בְּצֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶה פָנֶיךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶךָ
items.quote: For [my] righteousness let me behold Your face. Upon awakening [in the World to Come] I will be gratified [to behold] Your image.
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant you the privilege of life in the World to come.

items.title: BAD INFLUENCES
items.he: אֲנִי שָׁמַרְתִּי אָרְחוֹת פָּרִיץ
items.quote: I have guarded against the ways of the offender.
items.text: Avoid interacting with people who do not observe the mitzvos.

items.title: LUXURIES
items.he: חֶלְבָּמוֹ סָּגְרוּ פִּימוֹ דִּבְּרוּ בְגֵאוּת
items.quote: They have covered [their heart] with their fat; their mouths speak with arrogance.
items.text: Avoid indulging in conspicuous luxuries. Such behavior breeds arrogance and makes you feel that you have no need to seek sustenance from Your Creator.

items.title: HELP WITH MITZVOS
items.he: תָּמֹךְ אֲשֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶיךָ, בַּל נָמוֹטּוּ פְעָמָי
items.quote: Support my steps in Your pathways so that my feet do not trip.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you in your desire to observe His mitzvos. Make the case that you do not want to fail Him because of your weaknesses.

items.title: NATURAL DEATH
items.he: מִמְתִים יָדְךָ ה’, מִמְתִים מֵחֶלֶד
items.quote: Hashem, [let me be] from among those who die by Your hand, who die of old age.
items.text: Ask Hashem that when it is time for you to leave this world it will be a natural death and that you will not be the victim of violence.

items.title: DIVINE PRESENCE
items.he: בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי
items.quote: Shelter me in the shadow of Your wings.
items.text: Ask Hashem to let your enemies fear to attack you because they sense His watchful presence.

items.title: SHELTER
items.he: מִפְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים זוּ שַׁדּוּנִי, אֹיְבַי בְּנֶפֶשׁ יַקִּיפוּ עָלָי
items.quote: [Shelter me] from those resha’im who rob me, my mortal enemies who encircle me.
items.text: Ask Hashem to protect you from evil men who are seeking to cause you harm.

items.title: DELAYED ATTACK
items.he: פַּלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי מֵרָשָׁע חַרְבֶּךָ
items.quote: Rescue my soul from the rasha, [acting as] Your sword.
items.text: Ask Hashem to stop the rasha who is out to harm you. Ask that his attack be delayed to give you the opportunity to do teshuvah.

18.title: A Lifetime of Devotion
18.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: TOTAL DEVOTION
items.he: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד ה’ לְדָוִד
items.quote: For the musician, by the servant of Hashem, by David.
items.text: Aspire to identify yourself as an eved (servant) of Hashem, following David’s example. This means no matter where you go, no matter what you do, your thoughts should always be of Hashem, your Master.

items.title: TODAY
items.he: בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל ה’ אוֹתוֹ
items.quote: On a day that Hashem had delivered him.
items.text: Your gratitude to Hashem for all that He has done for you over the course of your life should be fresh and vibrant, as though it happened today.

items.title: FORTRESS
items.he: ה’ סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי
items.quote: Hashem is my Rock, my Fortress.
items.text: As you express your total reliance on Hashem, form images in your mind of His fortress-like strength as it pertains to you personally.

items.title: LOVE
items.he: אֶרְחָמְךָ ה’ חִזְקִי
items.quote: I will [sing of my] love for You, Hashem, for You are my Strength.
items.text: As you express your love for Hashem in song, think how He provides you with the strength to face all challenges that life has to offer.

items.title: UNCONDITIONAL BOND
items.he: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא ה’ וּמִן אֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ
items.quote: I call unto Hashem with praise. I am saved from my enemies.
items.text: Think of your feeling of love towards Hashem as being unconditional, based on lifelong gratitude. Thus, you want to praise Him even when you are not in distress. His love for you will then also be unconditional. He will save you from enemies without even having to ask for help.

items.title: SANCTIFY THE NAME
items.he: עַל כֵּן אוֹדְךָ בַגּוֹיִם ה’ וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה
items.quote: Therefore, I shall give thanks to You among the nations, Hashem. I will sing praise to Your Name.
items.text: Share your experiences and your knowledge of Hashem with all people within the sound of your voice.

19.title: Seeking Perfection
19.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: THE WONDERS OF THE HEAVENS
items.he: הַשָּׁמַיִם מְסַפְּרִים כְּבוֹד אֵ־ל וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו מַגִּיד הָרָקִיעַ
items.quote: The [outer] heavens tell the glory of G-d but [the full perfection of] His handiwork is declared by the [inner] sky.
items.text: All of the heavens are a demonstration of the glory of Hashem, but especially the interaction between the atmosphere and mankind’s needs.

items.title: TIME
items.he: יוֹם לְיוֹם יַבִּיעַ אֹמֶר וְלַיְלָה לְּלַיְלָה יְחַוֶּה דָּעַת
items.quote: [Each] day promises a following day and [each] night expresses the knowledge of a following night.
items.text: Hashem created the dimension of time within which mankind exists. We cannot even imagine existence outside of time. Time moves forward inexorably under Hashem’s direction, but at the same time it operates within rigidly controlled calendar cycles. Just as we rely completely on the controlled passage of time, we can rely completely on Hashem’s direction of our lives.

items.title: ABSOLUTE OBEDIENCE
items.he: בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ יָצָא קַוָּם
items.quote: The line stretches forth throughout the world.
items.text: Hashem sees to it that the heavenly bodies adhere to their orbital paths. None would dare deviate. Those who observe the controlled movements of bodies through space have a special sense of closeness to Creation.

items.title: PERFECTION
items.he: תּוֹרַת ה’ תְּמִימָה מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ
items.quote: Hashem’s Torah is perfect; it restores the soul.
items.text: You may not fully appreciate the gift of Hashem’s Torah until you realize that its perfection matches and exceeds the perfection of the heavens.

items.title: JOY IN DUTY
items.he: הוּא כְּחָתָן יֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ יָשִׂישׂ כְּגִבּוֹר לָרוּץ אֹרַח
items.quote: It is like a bridegroom as he emerges from his wedding canopy, like a warrior who rejoices in running his course.
items.text: You should take a lesson from the sun which rejoices in being given the opportunity to do its duty and fulfill its destiny in Hashem’s Creation.

items.title: UNINTENTIONAL SINS
items.he: שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי יָבִין מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּנִי
items.quote: Who can be aware of unintentional sins? Cleanse me from unwitting faults.
items.text: Ask Hashem to forgive the sins that you commit through lack of attention. As human beings we are physically unable to give full attention to every aspect of our lives and therefore we are subject to unintentional sin. Perfection eludes us but that should not prevent us from seeking it.

items.title: SINCERITY
items.he: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ
items.quote: May the utterances of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart find favor before You.
items.text: Your tefillos have little value if they are not sincere. As you pray you should ask yourself whether you will be able to honestly make this concluding plea to Hashem, begging Him to find favor in your thoughts and words.

20.title: May Hashem Answer You
20.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: DISTRESS
items.he: יַעַנְךָ ה’ בְּיוֹם צָרָה
items.quote: May Hashem answer you on the day of distress.
items.text: No matter how difficult your situation in life becomes, you should call upon Hashem to help you. If those you love are in distress, pray to Hashem to help them and respond to their tefillos.

items.title: ANSWERING THE CALL
items.he: הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵנוּ
items.quote: May the King answer us on the day we call.

items.title: KEEPING THE PROMISE
items.he: שֵׁם אֱלֹקֵי יַעֲקֹב
items.quote: the Name of Yaakov’s G-d.
items.text: Over the course of Yaakov’s life he faced many difficult challenges. But Hashem promised to protect Yaakov and He kept His promise. Therefore, you should humbly turn to Him to do the same for you.

items.title: THE SOURCE OF HELP
items.he: יִשְׁלַח עֶזְרְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ
items.quote: May He send your help from the Mikdash.
items.text: The true yeshuah will come only from Hashem. Don’t rely on help from the nations of the world.

items.title: MILITARY POWER
items.he: וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם ה’ אֱלֹקֵינוּ נַזְכִּיר
items.quote: We call out the Name of Hashem, our G-d.
items.text: Don’t rely on the force of arms to save you in time of distress. Turn to Hashem.

items.title: YOUR PLANS
items.he: וְכָל עֲצָתְךָ יְמַלֵּא
items.quote: May He fulfill your every plan.
items.text: If you are planning a worthy project, ask for Hashem’s help in bringing success.

items.title: JOY IN VICTORY
items.he: נְרַנְּנָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ
items.quote: We will sing joyously because of Your deliverance.
items.text: Express your gratitude to Hashem in public song.

21.title: A King’s Gratitude
21.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah to Hashem.

items.title: STRENGTH
items.he: ה’ בְּעָזְּךָ יִשְׂמַח מֶלֶךְ
items.quote: Hashem, a king rejoices in Your strength.
items.text: If you have succeeded in overcoming a challenge, celebrate your achievement in gratitude to Hashem, for what appears to be your strength is actually His strength.

items.title: HEART’S DESIRE
items.he: תַּאֲוַת לִבּוֹ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ
items.quote: You have granted him his heart’s desire.
items.text: Strive to be able to serve Hashem at an ever higher level of purity and holiness.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: כִּי הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵחַ בַּה’ וּבְחֶסֶד עֶלְיוֹן בַּל יִמּוֹט
items.quote: For the king trusts in Hashem and in the kindness of the Most High he will not falter.
items.text: Even if you have acquired wealth and power, don’t neglect your complete trust in Hashem. If you rely only upon Him you can hope to maintain your status and be able to continue to do good with your wealth.

items.title: A LONG LIFE
items.he: חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ אֹרֶךְ יָמִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד
items.quote: He asked You for life; You granted it to him, length of days forever and ever.
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant you a long life so that you can live out your days in serving Him.

items.title: ENEMIES
items.he: תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לְכָל אֹיְבֶיךָ יְמִינְךָ תִּמְצָא שֹׂנְאֶיךָ
items.quote: May Your hand find all Your enemies; may Your right hand find those who hate You.
items.text: If you are threatened by evil men, ask Hashem to take action against them, for they are His enemies.

items.title: STRENGTH
items.he: רוּמָה ה’ בְּעֻזֶּךָ נָשִׁירָה וּנְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶךָ
items.quote: Be exalted, Hashem, in Your strength! We will sing and chant the praise of Your might.
items.text: Inspire others through song to recognize the power of Hashem.

22.title: The Morning Star
22.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah and some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor.

items.title: FORSAKEN
items.he: אֵ־לִי אֵ־לִי לָמָה עֲזַבְתָּנִי
items.quote: My G-d, my G-d, why have You forsaken me.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to restore His bond with you.

items.he: אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי כִּי צָרָה קְרוֹבָה כִּי אֵין עוֹזֵר
items.quote: [Hashem,] be not distant from me because my trouble is near, there is nobody to help.

items.title: ENTHRONEMENT
items.he: וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל
items.quote: You are the Holy One, enthroned [upon] the praises of Yisrael.
items.text: Hashem eagerly awaits the praises and the devotion of His people and He responds to them.

items.title: FOREFATHERS
items.he: בְּךָ בָּטְחוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ בָּטְחוּ וַתְּפַלְּטֵמוֹ
items.quote: Our fathers trusted in You; they trusted and You delivered them.
items.text: Don’t be discouraged by the long wait for a yeshuah. Our forefathers trusted in Hashem and their patience was rewarded. So it will be with us.

items.title: SCORNED
items.he: אָנֹכִי תוֹלַעַת וְלֹא אִישׁ חֶרְפַּת אָדָם וּבְזוּי עָם
items.quote: But [now] I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men, reviled by nations.
items.text: I and my people are the objects of scorn and hatred among the nations. We look to You, Hashem to restore us.

items.title: TURN TO HASHEM
items.he: גֹּל אֶל ה’ יְפַלְּטֵהוּ יַצִּילֵהוּ כִּי חָפֵץ בּוֹ
items.quote: The one who turns to Hashem, He will free him! He will rescue him, for He is pleased with him.
items.text: Hashem gave you your life. You should dedicate it to the service of Hashem with the goal of pleasing Him.

items.title: BIRTH
items.he: כִּי אַתָּה גֹחִי מִבָּטֶן
items.quote: For You, [Hashem,] drew me forth from the womb.
items.text: Hashem gave you life and security from the very beginning of your existence.

items.title: SHARE YOUR GRATITUDE
items.he: אֲסַפְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לְאֶחָי בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל אֲהַלְלֶךָּ
items.quote: [Hashem,] I will proclaim Your Name to my brethren, I will praise You in the midst of the assembly.
items.text: Share your gratitude and inspire others.

items.he: יָבֹאוּ וְיַגִּידוּ צִדְקָתוֹ לְעַם נוֹלָד כִּי עָשָׂה
items.quote: They will come and relate His charitable act, which He has done to the newborn nation [of Yisrael].

23.title: A Shepherd’s Tale
23.intro: Listed below are some of the thoughts that you might have in mind when you say or sing the words of the mizmor as a tefillah.

items.title: SHEPHERD
items.he: ה’ רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר
items.quote: Hashem is my Shepherd I will not lack.
items.text: Think of Hashem as your shepherd Who provides for all your needs.

items.title: CONTINUING PRESENCE
items.he: לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
items.quote: I will not fear evil for You are with me.
items.text: Remember that Hashem is always with you.

items.title: TRANQUILITY
items.he: עַל מֵי מְנֻחוֹת יְנַהֲלֵנִי
items.quote: He leads me beside tranquil waters.
items.text: Be grateful that you are leading a relatively tranquil life.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.he: יַנְחֵנִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי צֶדֶק
items.quote: He leads me on righteous pathways.
items.text: Be grateful that Hashem has given you the Torah and talmidei chachamim to interpret it.

items.title: WORLDLY SUCCESS
items.he: תַּעֲרֹךְ לְפָנַי שֻׁלְחָן
items.quote: You set out a table before me.
items.text: Give thanks to Hashem for your worldly success.

items.title: YOUR MISSION
items.he: דִּשַּׁנְתָּ בַשֶּׁמֶן רֹאשִׁי כּוֹסִי רְוָיָה
items.quote: You have anointed my head with oil; my cup is full.
items.text: Give thanks to Hashem for giving you a mission in life and giving you the means to fulfill it.

items.title: MIDDOS
items.he: אַךְ טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּי
items.quote: But may goodness and kindness pursue me all the days of my life.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you perfect your middos so that virtuous behavior will come naturally to you.

items.title: DWELLING
items.he: וְשַׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית ה’ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים
items.quote: and let me dwell in the House of Hashem, for the length of [my] days.
items.text: Ask Hashem for the privilege of learning Torah and doing His will.

24.title: Receiving the King
24.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: CREATION
items.he: לַה’ הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ
items.quote: The earth and all it contains belong to Hashem, the world and those who dwell in it.
items.text: Hashem assumed possession of the world by creating it. As part of that Creation we are obliged to serve Him.

items.title: QUALIFICATIONS
items.he: מִי יַעֲלֶה בְהַר ה’ וּמִי יָקוּם בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ
items.quote: Who may go up to the mountain of Hashem and who may stand up in the place of His sanctity?
items.text: You need to work on elevating your behavior to be justified to approaching Hashem in the place of His sanctity.

items.he: נְקִי כַפַּיִם וּבַר לֵבָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה
items.quote: The clean of hands and pure of heart, who has not sworn in vain by My Name and has not sworn deceitfully.

items.title: GLORY
items.he: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד
items.quote: Raise up your heads, O gates, and be raised you everlasting portals. Let the King of Glory enter.
items.text: The honor given to an earthly king is only a hint of the honor that is due to the Creator. You should be especially respectful in the place which He has chosen for His Shechinah to dwell (e.g. the Bais Hamikdash or a Bais Hamidrash).

items.title: SEEKING
items.he: זֶה דּוֹר דֹּרְשָׁיו מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה
items.quote: Such is the generation of those who sincerely seek [Hashem] and appeal to Your Presence, [the children of] Yaakov, Selah.
items.text: You should desire to be among those who are seekers of Hashem, which means you want to be closer to your Creator and you earnestly seek His favor.

25.title: A Personal Tefillah
25.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: COMMITMENT
items.he: אֵלֶיךָ ה’ נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא
items.quote: I lift my soul to You, Hashem.
items.text: Commit yourself totally to the service of your Creator by concentrating all of your mental and emotional resources on the words of your tefillos to Him.

items.title: PITY
items.he: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כִּי יָחִיד וְעָנִי אָנִי:
items.quote: Turn to me and have pity on me for I am alone and impoverished.
items.text: Plead with Hashem to grant you His favor because you have no one to help you out of your present difficulties. Even if you feel that you have been challenged with a unique trouble and that nobody is suffering as you are, don’t be discouraged but turn to Hashem.

items.title: BEING SHAMED
items.he: אֱלֹקַי בְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי אַל אֵבוֹשָׁה אַל יַעַלְצוּ אֹיְבַי לִי
items.quote: My G-d, in You I have trusted. Let me not be shamed. Let my enemies not gloat over me.
items.text: Ask Hashem to keep you from being shamed before those who wish to harm you because your enemies are His enemies and your defeat will be a reflection on the One in Whom you have trusted.

items.title: FUTURE DELIVERANCE
items.he: גַּם כָּל קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ
items.quote: Let all those who look with hope to You also not be shamed.
items.text: Ask Hashem not to limit His deliverance to you, but to grant it to all who have bitachon in Him throughout the coming years.

items.title: TORAH
items.he: דְּרָכֶיךָ ה’ הוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרְחוֹתֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי
items.quote: Make Your ways known to me, Hashem. Teach me Your paths.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you learn and understand the Torah.

items.title: EARLY SINS
items.he: חַטֹּאות נְעוּרַי וּפְשָׁעַי אַל תִּזְכֹּר
items.quote: Don’t recall the sins and offenses of my youth.
items.text: Ask Hashem to treat your early sins as though they never happened, for you were carried away by the foolishness of youth.

items.title: RECENT SINS
items.he: לְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ ה’ וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֹנִי כִּי רַב הוּא
items.quote: Hashem, because of Your Name, absolve me of my serious transgression even though it is great.
items.text: Confess the seriousness of your sins and ask Hashem to forgive you. If your sincere He will surely do so because of His Name (“good and upright.)” Bear in mind that your sins are painful to Hashem. Therefore if you feel anguish about the effect upon Him of the greatness of your sins, that would be a reason for Him to absolve you of them.

items.title: GOOD AND UPRIGHT
items.he: טוֹב וְיָשָׁר ה’ עַל כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּרֶךְ
items.quote: Hashem is good and upright. Therefore He guides sinners on the way.
items.text: You can trust Hashem to do what is right and to do what is best for you, because He cares for your well-being and gives you the help you need, if you ask for it.

items.title: COMMITMENT
items.he: יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וִילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּוֹ
items.quote: He guides the humble in justice and He teaches His way to the humble.

items.title: THE MYSTERY
items.he: סוֹד ה’ לִירֵאָיו וּבְרִיתוֹ לְהוֹדִיעָם
items.quote: The mystery of Hashem is for those who fear Him. And He makes known His covenant to them.
items.text: Hashem’s Torah has infinite depths, which are revealed to those who are worthy.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.he: יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וִילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּוֹ
items.quote: He guides the humble in justice and He teaches His way to the humble.
items.text: By practising humility you will become worthy of acquiring the wisdom of the Torah. The best example for this is Moshe Rabbeinu, who excelled in humility and in knowledge of the Torah, which he taught to his nation.

items.title: GOOD CHILDREN
items.he: נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין וְזַרְעוֹ יִירַשׁ אָרֶץ
items.quote: His soul will abide in goodness and his offspring will inherit the land.
items.text: There is a connection between the goodness with which you conduct your home and the effect upon your children, so that they will follow the way of Hashem and become worthy of inheriting the land of life.

items.title: REDEMPTION
items.he: פְּדֵה אֱלֹקִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל צָרוֹתָיו
items.quote: O G-d, redeem Yisrael from all its troubles.
items.text: Even if you are not worthy, plead with Hashem to save your nation.

26.title: A Personal Review
26.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: SINCERITY
items.he: שָׁפְטֵנִי ה’ כִּי אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי הָלַכְתִּי
items.quote: Judge me, Hashem for I walked in my own innocence.
items.text: Prepare yourself to be judged by Hashem. This means that even though your actions are not what they should be, at least you have been sincere with Hashem and honest with yourself about serving Him and doing what is right.

items.he: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי אֵלֵךְ
items.quote: As for me, I will walk in my innocence.

items.title: SELF-EXAMINATION
items.he: בְּחָנֵנִי ה’ וְנַסֵּנִי צָרְפָה כִלְיוֹתַי וְלִבִּי
items.quote: Examine me, Hashem. Test me; purify my conscience and my heart.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you analyze the sincerity and honesty of your thoughts. Examine yourself to identify any hidden personal agenda that is undermining your eagerness to do the will of Hashem.

items.title: HASHEM’S KINDNESS
items.he: כִּי חַסְדְּךָ לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי
items.quote: For Your kindness is before my eyes.
items.text: Think about all the kindnesses that Hashem does for you every day and ask yourself about whether you can improve your efforts at showing gratitude by doing His will.

items.title: BAD INFLUENCES
items.he: לֹא יָשַׁבְתִּי עִם מְתֵי שָׁוְא וְעִם נַעֲלָמִים לֹא אָבוֹא
items.quote: I have not sat down with idlers; I did not come into the company of hypocrites.
items.text: Avoid people who might weaken your resolve to always do what is right.

items.he: שָׂנֵאתִי קְהַל מְרֵעִים וְעִם רְשָׁעִים לֹא אֵשֵׁב
items.quote: I hated a community of evildoers; I did not sit with the wicked.

items.title: TESHUVAH
items.he: אֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי
items.quote: I will wash my hands with purity.
items.text: Cleanse yourself through teshuvah so that you will be worthy of serving Hashem.

items.title: PUBLIC THANKS
items.he: לַשְׁמִעַ בְּקוֹל תּוֹדָה וּלְסַפֵּר כָּל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ
items.quote: to proclaim aloud gratitude and to tell of all Your wonders.
items.text: Demonstrate the enthusiasm of your gratitude by publicly proclaiming the wonders you have seen and experienced.

items.he: בְּמַקְהֵלִים אֲבָרֵךְ ה’
items.quote: I will bless Hashem in public assemblies.

items.title: LOVE
items.he: ה’ אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ
items.quote: Hashem, I love the shelter of Your House and the dwelling place of Your glory.
items.text: You should feel a sense of love and affection upon entering Hashem’s house, for it is there you will be closer to Him.

27.title: Reconciling Bitachon to Tefillah
27.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: LIGHT
items.he: ה’ אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי
items.quote: Hashem is my light and my yeshuah.
items.text: Even when you are experiencing the darkness of anxiety and depression, look to Your bitachon in Hashem to find a source of light. Remember that your future is in His loving and capable hands. The yeshuah is sure to come.

items.he: אִם תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה, בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵחַ
items.quote: Even if a battle would be initiated against me, I would trust in this.

items.title: COURAGE
items.he: קַוֵּה אֶל ה’ חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל ה’
items.quote: Hope to Hashem; strengthen yourself and He will give your heart courage.
items.text: Even if you are facing difficult challenges, remember that Hashem is there with you and will help you do what is right.

items.title: HASHEM’S HOUSE
items.he: שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית ה’ כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי
items.quote: [One thing I have asked] that I dwell in the House of Hashem all the days of my life.
items.text: Ask Hashem to enable you to live in an environment where you can see Him and be close to Him.

items.title: TEFILLAH
items.he: שְׁמַע ה’ קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא וְחָנֵּנִי וַעֲנֵנִי
items.quote: Hashem, hear my voice as I call. Favor me with Your kindness and answer me.
items.text: Speak to Hashem and ask Him to favor you with His kindness even though you are unworthy.

items.he: אַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי אַל תַּט בְּאַף עַבְדֶּךָ
items.quote: Don’t hide Your face from me, don’t turn away Your servant in anger.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.he: הוֹרֵנִי ה’ דַּרְכֶּךָ וּנְחֵנִי בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר
items.quote: Teach me Your way, Hashem, and lead me on a level path.
items.text: Ask Hashem to guide you in making the right choices in life and put you in a situation where the choices are clear.

items.title: SONGS OF PRAISE
items.he: אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה לַה’
items.quote: [There] will I sing and chant praise to Hashem.
items.text: Sing out your expressions of praise and gratitude to Hashem so that others will be inspired to follow suit.

28.title: Differentiation
28.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: ONLY ONE
items.he: אֵלֶיךָ ה’ אֶקְרָא
items.quote: I call to You Hashem.
items.text: You are declaring your personal bond to Hashem. You are calling to Him because you trust in no other power.

items.title: DIALOG
items.he: אַל תֶּחֱרַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי פֶּן תֶּחֱשֶׁה מִמֶּנִּי
items.quote: Don’t be deaf to me, lest You [then] be mute to me.
items.text: Beg Hashem not to ignore you, but to interact with you, listening to what you have to say and responding to you. Watch for His response in His actions toward you and in the thoughts that come in to your mind.

items.he: שְׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ
items.quote: Hear the sound of my supplications when I cry out to You.

items.title: DIFFERENTIATION
items.he: אַל תִּמְשְׁכֵנִי עִם רְשָׁעִים וְעִם פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן
items.quote: Don’t draw me along with resha’im, nor with wrongdoers.
items.text: Ask Hashem to keep you apart from wicked people, not to let you be influenced by them and not to let you be absorbed into their calamitous destiny.

items.title: YESHUAH
items.he: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ
items.quote: Save Your people.
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant a yeshuah, not only for yourself, but for all of Yisrael.

items.title: GIVING THOUGHT
items.he: כִּי לֹא יָבִינוּ אֶל פְּעֻלֹּת ה’ וְאֶל מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו
items.quote: For they do not give thought to the deeds of Hashem and His handiwork.
items.text: Pay attention to the wonders of the world that Hashem created.

items.title: SHOW OF HANDS
items.he: בְּנָשְׂאִי יָדַי אֶל דְּבִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ
items.quote: I lift my hands towards Your Holy Sanctuary.
items.text: Express emotion in tefillah by raising your hands in your ardor.

items.title: ANTICIPATION
items.he: בָּרוּךְ ה’ כִּי שָׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי
items.quote: Blessed is Hashem for He has heard the sound of my supplications.
items.text: Thank Hashem even before you have evidence that He has heard you.

items.he: בָטַח לִבִּי וְנֶעֱזָרְתִּי
items.quote: My heart trusted in Him and I was helped.

items.title: SONGS OF PRAISE
items.he: וַיַּעֲלֹז לִבִּי וּמִשִּׁירִי אֲהוֹדֶנּוּ
items.quote: My heart exults and I will praise Him with my song:
items.text: Sing out your expressions of praise and gratitude to Hashem so that others will be inspired to follow suit.

29.title: Preparing for Avodah
29.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah asking for your needs, or expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: THE AVOS
items.he: הָבוּ לַה’ בְּנֵי אֵלִים, הָבוּ לַה’ כָּבוֹד וָעֹז
items.quote: Give [homage] to Hashem, O you sons of the mighty. Give [homage] to Hashem [for His] glory and might.
items.text: Give public honor to the Creator, calling upon the kedushah achieved by our Avos.

items.he: הָבוּ לַה’ כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַה’ בְּהַדְרַת קֹדֶשׁ
items.quote: Give [homage] to Hashem [for] the honor of His Name. Bow down to Hashem [for] the splendor of [His] holiness.

items.title: THUNDERING
items.he: קוֹל ה’ עַל הַמָּיִם אֵ־ל הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים ה’ עַל מַיִם רַבִּים
items.quote: The voice of Hashem is over the waters. The G-d of glory is thundering, Hashem is over the mighty waters.
items.text: When you hear the sound of thunder you are hearing the voice of Hashem.

items.title: LIGHTNING
items.he: קוֹל ה’ חֹצֵב לַהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ
items.quote: The voice of Hashem carves out flames of fire.
items.text: When you see the flash and hear the crack of lightning you are witnessing the power of Hashem.

items.title: HARMONY OF PEACE
items.he: ה’ עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן ה’ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם
items.quote: Hashem is giving the strength [of the Torah] to His nation and Hashem will bless His nation with peace.
items.text: Look to the Torah to appreciate the grandeur of Hashem. The harmonious relationships among all the parts of the Torah and among all the parts of the natural world correspond to the blessing of peace which Hashem offers to Yisrael.

30.title: Inauguration of the House
30.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: EFFORT
items.he: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר חֲנֻכַּת הַבַּיִת לְדָוִד
items.quote: A mizmor for the inauguration of the Bais HaMikdash, by David.
items.text: Learn from David’s example and do whatever you can to serve Hashem, even when you know you will not be able to see your project through to completion. It is your duty to put your efforts into doing what is right (hishtadlus), while recognizing that what ultimately happens depends on the will of Hashem.

items.title: PAST AND FUTURE
items.he: כִּי רֶגַע בְּאַפּוֹ חַיִּים בִּרְצוֹנוֹ
items.quote: For His anger lasts but a moment while His favor is for a lifetime.
items.text: When life seems to go against you and you find that you are experiencing the anger of Hashem, remember that His anger is short relative to the time of His good will toward you in the past. Also remember that His anger serves an important purpose. (1) It makes you appreciate how good it was to have His good will up to now. (2) It encourages you to prepare yourself for a restoration of His good will in the future.

items.title: SELF-DELUSION
items.he: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִי בַּל אֶמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם
items.quote: I said in my serenity, ‘I will never falter.’
items.text: When things go well for you, you may be grateful, but if that good fortune persists over a period of time, you will be tempted to believe it is your own doing or just good luck. This is a delusion. Then when things turn bad for you, you will realize that your “mountain of strength” that you thought could never falter, was actually granted by the favor of Hashem.

items.he: ה’ בִּרְצוֹנְךָ הֶעֱמַדְתָּה לְהַרְרִי עֹז
items.quote: Hashem, with Your favor You supported my mountain of strength..
