items.he: הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ הָיִיתִי נִבְהָל
items.quote: As soon as You hid Your face I became disconcerted.
items.text: You became like a small child whose parents are hidden from him.

items.title: A MEASURE OF THANKS
items.he: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ ה’ כִּי דִלִּיתָנִי
items.quote: I raise You on high, Hashem, for You have drawn me up.
items.text: The greater the kindness that Hashem has shown to you, the greater is your duty to show gratitude to Him.

items.title: TWOFOLD JOY
items.he: וְלֹא שִׂמַּחְתָּ אֹיְבַי לִי
items.quote: You have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
items.text: Be grateful that the resha’im have not been given the opportunity to rejoice and that they have not been given the opportunity to enjoy the public weakening of respect for Hashem.

items.title: PERSONAL THANKS
items.he: ה’ אֱלֹקָי שִׁוַּעְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵנִי
items.quote: Hashem, my G-d, I cried out to You alone and You healed me.
items.text: In thanking Hashem, recognize your personal relationship to Him. You didn’t just get healed; it was He who healed you.

items.title: ETERNAL THANKS
items.he: ה’ אֱלֹקַי לְעוֹלָם אוֹדֶךָּ
items.quote: Hashem, my G-d, I will forever thank You.
items.text: A major purpose of life is the opportunity to thank Hashem. Therefore you should never waste a minute of the time when you are able to fulfill this mission. By continuing to thank Him in this world you will merit the opportunity to continue doing so in the World to Come.

items.title: DEVOTION
items.he: זַמְּרוּ לַה’ חֲסִידָיו
items.quote: Sing to Hashem, [all of you who are] His devout ones.
items.text: It is not enough to be devout. Your devotion should encompass a strong sense of love toward Hashem. Be one of “His” devout ones.

items.title: REACTION
items.he: אֵלֶיךָ ה’ אֶקְרָא וְאֶל אֲדֹ־נָי אֶתְחַנָּן
items.quote: I will call to You, Hashem, I will appeal to my L-rd.
items.text: When you experience any kind of distress, your reaction should be to turn to Hashem. Recognize that the purpose of such an event is to motivate you to call to Him.

items.title: JUSTIFICATION
items.he: מַה בֶּצַע בְּדָמִי בְּרִדְתִּי אֶל שָׁחַת
items.quote: What gain is there for my soul in my descent to the grave?
items.text: The basis for any appeal that you make to Hashem should not be a self-serving benefit, but to be granted an opportunity to do His will and serve Him in this life.

items.he: הֲיוֹדְךָ עָפָר הֲיַגִּיד אֲמִתֶּךָ
items.quote: Will the dust acknowledge You? Will it declare Your truth?
items.text: Although the souls in the World to Come will have the opportunity of praising Hashem in a state of unending glory, this still cannot equal the value to Hashem of a person praising Him out of his own free will in this world.

items.title: RESPONSE
items.he: וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ
items.quote: and give thanks to His holy Name.
items.text: When you hear someone describe the miracles that Hashem has performed for him, you should respond by praising His Name.

items.title: PAST AND FUTURE
items.he: בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּה
items.quote: The weeping in the evening stays overnight but there is a cry of joy in the morning.
items.text: The anguish that you experience in difficult times prepares for the joy you will feel when Hashem smiles upon you again. This includes future times of simchah in this world as well as in the World to Come.

items.title: THE GIFT OF LIFE
items.he: לְמַעַן יְזַמֶּרְךָ כָבוֹד וְלֹא יִדֹּם
items.quote: So that [my] soul might sing to You and not be stilled.
items.text: The true bitterness of death is not being immersed in Torah and mitzvos.

31.title: Rebuilding Bitachon
31.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: EMBARRASSMENT
items.he: בְּךָ ה’ חָסִיתִי אַל אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ פַלְּטֵנִי
items.quote: I have sought refuge with You, Hashem. Let me never feel embarrassed. In Your generous goodwill, save me.
items.text: Ask Hashem to protect you and save you for you are depending on no one but Him. Ask that you never be embarrassed at having relied on Hashem.

items.he: ה’ אַל אֵבוֹשָׁה כִּי קְרָאתִיךָ
items.quote: Hashem, let me not feel disheartened after having called upon You.

items.title: INCLINE YOUR EAR
items.he: הַטֵּה אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ
items.quote: Incline Your ear to me.
items.text: Tell Hashem that even if your tefillah is not sufficiently worthy to ascend to Him, He should incline His ear to you and hear you.

items.title: ENTRUSTING MY LIFE
items.he: בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי
items.quote: I will entrust my living spirit into Your hand.
items.text: Appeal to Hashem to save you because you depend on Him alone.

items.title: A SHINING FACE
items.he: הָאִירָה פָנֶיךָ עַל עַבְדֶּךָ
items.quote: Shine Your face upon Your servant.
items.text: Ask Hashem to show you His love and goodwill. By shining His face openly upon you, the world will see that Hashem rewards those who are devoted to Him.

items.title: FORTRESS
items.he: כִּי סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה
items.quote: For You have been my towering Rock and You have been my Fortress.
items.text: Hashem is totally reliable, like the most impenetrable fortress.

items.title: GOODNESS
items.he: מָה רַב טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר צָפַנְתָּ לִּירֵאֶיךָ
items.quote: How abundant is Your goodness that You have hidden away for those who fear You.
items.text: Hashem’s true goodness is reserved for those who appreciate it.

items.title: TIME TO HATE
items.he: שָׂנֵאתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַבְלֵי שָׁוְא
items.quote: I have come to hate those who depend on worthless fantasies.
items.text: Hatred of evil is sometimes necessary to avoid being caught up in it.

items.title: LOVE AND DEVOTION
items.he: אֶהֱבוּ אֶת ה’ כָּל חֲסִידָיו
items.quote: Love Hashem, all His devout ones!
items.text: Love of Hashem must be based on your complete and faithful devotion to Him alone.

items.title: COURAGE
items.he: חִזְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵץ לְבַבְכֶם כָּל הַמְיַחֲלִים לַה’
items.quote: Be strong, and your hearts will take courage, all who wait longingly for Hashem.
items.text: No matter how difficult things are for you, have confidence that the yeshuah will surely come.

items.title: A SHINING FACE
items.he: הָאִירָה פָנֶיךָ עַל עַבְדֶּךָ
items.quote: Shine Your face upon Your servant.
items.text: Emulate the attributes of Hashem and show goodwill towards all the people in your life. Showing a smile can be a great kindness.

items.title: EMPATHY
items.he: אָגִילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָה בְּחַסְדֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֶת עָנְיִי
items.quote: I will feel exultation. I will rejoice in Your loving kindness that You have seen my affliction.
items.text: Thank Hashem for His sympathetic and understanding care in easing your difficulties. When you realize His personal concern you should feel a burst of exultation.

items.title: FREE WILL
items.he: הֶעֱמַדְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָב רַגְלָי
items.quote: You have set my feet on a wide-open place.
items.text: Thank Hashem for giving you the freedom to choose your way in life. Humbly ask for His guidance in making the right choice.

items.title: SECURITY
items.he: בָּרוּךְ ה’ כִּי הִפְלִיא חַסְדּוֹ לִי בְּעִיר מָצוֹר
items.quote: Blessed is Hashem, for He has been wondrously kind to me, [secure as] in a fortified city.
items.text: Thank Hashem for making you feel secure.

items.title: YEARS OF PAIN
items.he: כִּי כָלוּ בְיָגוֹן חַיַּי וּשְׁנוֹתַי בַּאֲנָחָה
items.quote: For my life is consumed with anguish and my years with sighing.
items.text: By declaring and contemplating your suffering, you are demonstrating that its purpose has been served and your tefillah for a yeshuah should be answered.

32.title: Teshuvah is the Answer
32.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: TESHUVAH
items.he: אַשְׁרֵי נְשׂוּי פֶּשַׁע כְּסוּי חֲטָאָה
items.quote: Fortunate is [the man] whose transgression has been forgiven, his sin covered over.
items.text: Set a personal goal of becoming free of sin through teshuvah. If you do teshuvah sincerely and without reservation, your sins will be forgiven.

items.he: חַטָּאתִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ וַעֲוֹנִי לֹא כִסִּיתִי אָמַרְתִּי אוֹדֶה עֲלֵי פְשָׁעַי לַה’
items.quote: I acknowledged my sin to You and did not cover up my guilt. I resolved that I would confess my full transgression to You, Hashem.

items.he: אַשְׂכִּילְךָ וְאוֹרְךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ זוּ תֵלֵךְ
items.quote: I will instruct you and enlighten you in which path to go.
items.text: Be receptive to guidance from people with wisdom and experience.

items.title: OPPORTUNE TIME
items.he: עַל זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל חָסִיד אֵלֶיךָ לְעֵת מְצֹא
items.quote: Therefore, [Hashem,] let every devout man pray to You at the opportune time.
items.text: If you are encountering problems in life, don’t wait until they get serious, but immediately turn to Hashem and sincerely ask Him to forgive your sins.

items.he: רַק לְשֵׁטֶף מַיִם רַבִּים אֵלָיו לֹא יַגִּיעוּ
items.quote: But a flood of mighty waters should not reach him.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.he: אַשְׂכִּילְךָ וְאוֹרְךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ זוּ תֵלֵךְ אִיעֲצָה עָלֶיךָ עֵינִי
items.quote: I will instruct you and enlighten you in which path to go. I will advise you with my eye.
items.text: Be receptive to the guidance of people with wisdom and experience.

items.title: RESISTANCE
items.he: אַל תִּהְיוּ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין
items.quote: Don’t be like a horse or mule, which is uncomprehending.
items.text: Don’t act foolishly by resisting good advice and by resisting what you know to be the proper course of action.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: רַבִּים מַכְאוֹבִים לָרָשָׁע וְהַבּוֹטֵחַ בַּה’ חֶסֶד יְסוֹבְבֶנּוּ
items.quote: Many things are painful to the wicked person. But he who trusts in Hashem is surrounded by lovingkindness.
items.text: Have bitachon in Hashem and you will be rewarded by gaining Hashem’s protection.

items.title: ANGELS
items.he: אַתָּה סֵתֶר לִי מִצַּר תִּצְּרֵנִי רָנֵּי פַלֵּט תְּסוֹבְבֵנִי
items.quote: You are my shelter. You protect from trouble. You surround me [with ministering angels] crying out, ‘Rescue!’.
items.text: Hashem will send His angels to protect you from your troubles if you turn to Him.

items.title: JOYFUL SONG
items.he: שִׂמְחוּ בַה’ וְגִילוּ צַדִּיקִים וְהַרְנִינוּ כָּל יִשְׁרֵי לֵב
items.quote: You righteous people, rejoice in Hashem and be delighted. Inspire joyful song in everyone who is upright of heart.
items.text: By publicly praising Hashem through song you will inspire others to recognize Him.

33.title: Contemplating Our Creator
33.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: JOYFUL SONG
items.he: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּה’ לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה
items.quote: You tzaddikim, cry out joyously to Hashem. Praise is fitting for the upright.
items.text: If you have done teshuvah, you are surely forgiven for your sins and so you may join the righteous people of the world in joyfully praising our Creator.

items.title: MUSIC
items.he: הוֹדוּ לַה’ בְּכִנּוֹר בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר זַמְּרוּ לוֹ
items.quote: Gratefully praise Hashem with the harp; sing to Him with the ten-tone bagpipe.
items.text: Add variety in your music of praise to reflect the many facets of Creation.

items.he: שִׁירוּ לוֹ שִׁיר חָדָשׁ הֵיטִיבוּ נַגֵּן בִּתְרוּעָה
items.quote: Sing to Him a new song; skillfully perform music with the sound of the trumpet.

items.title: RELATIONSHIP
items.he: אַשְׁרֵי הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר ה’ אֱלֹקָיו הָעָם בָּחַר לְנַחֲלָה לוֹ
items.quote: Fortunate is the nation whose G-d is Hashem, the people that He has chosen as His own inheritance.
items.text: We Jews rejoice together in our good fortune at having been granted a relationship with Hashem.

items.title: MIDDOS
items.he: כִּי יָשָׁר דְּבַר ה’ וְכָל מַעֲשֵׂהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָה
items.quote: For the word of Hashem is upright. All His deeds are with fairness.
items.text: The laws of nature are not chaotic, but are consistent and dependable. Hashem administers them with fairness and kindness.

items.he: אֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט חֶסֶד ה’ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ
items.quote: He loves righteous justice and [the discipline of] judgement. The earth is filled with the kindness of Hashem.

items.title: CREATION
items.he: בִּדְבַר ה’ שָׁמַיִם נַעֲשׂוּ וּבְרוּחַ פִּיו כָּל צְבָאָם
items.quote: The heavens were made by the word of Hashem and all their multitudes by the breath of His mouth.
items.text: Living beings were fashioned in astoundingly complex detail and are supported by the elaborate infrastructure of the physical world.

items.he: כֹּנֵס כַּנֵּד מֵי הַיָּם נֹתֵן בְּאֹצָרוֹת תְּהוֹמוֹת
items.quote: He gathers in the waters of the sea like a high wall. He puts them into storehouses of deep waters.

items.title: HISTORY
items.he: ה’ הֵפִיר עֲצַת גּוֹיִם הֵנִיא מַחְשְׁבוֹת עַמִּים
items.quote: Hashem revokes the counsel of nations. He thwarts the thoughts of peoples.
items.text: Hashem controls the course of history throughout all generations.

items.title: ETERNITY
items.he: עֲצַת ה’ לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד מַחְשְׁבוֹת לִבּוֹ לְדֹר וָדֹר
items.quote: The counsel of Hashem will endure forever. The thoughts of His heart [as expressed in His Torah] from generation to generation.
items.text: The Torah of Hashem is eternal, as are His principles of truth and goodness.

items.title: OMNISCIENCE
items.he: הַיֹּצֵר יַחַד לִבָּם הַמֵּבִין אֶל כָּל מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם
items.quote: He Who fashions their heart as one, He discerns all their doings.
items.text: Hashem observes all our actions and knows our motivations.

items.title: JUSTICE
items.he: הִנֵּה עֵין ה’ אֶל יְרֵאָיו לַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ
items.quote: Behold, the eye of Hashem is toward those who fear Him, to those who put their hope in His kindness.
items.text: Hashem rewards all who serve Him faithfully.

items.title: AWE
items.he: יִירְאוּ מֵה’ כָּל הָאָרֶץ מִמֶּנּוּ יָגוּרוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל
items.quote: Let the entire earth be in awe of Him. Let all inhabitants of the world fear Him.
items.text: Recognition and awareness of Hashem requires that you be in awe of Him.

items.title: DEVOTION
items.he: נַפְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָה לַה’ עֶזְרֵנוּ וּמָגִנֵּנוּ הוּא
items.quote: Our soul has waited for Hashem. He is our help and our shield.
items.text: Declare your bitachon and your devotion to Hashem.

items.he: כִּי בוֹ יִשְׂמַח לִבֵּנוּ כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ בָטָחְנוּ
items.quote: [We wait] because with Him our hearts will be glad, that we trusted in His Holy Name.

items.title: KINDNESS
items.he: יְהִי חַסְדְּךָ ה’ עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָךְ
items.quote: Hashem, may Your kindness be upon us, as we are hoping for You.
items.text: May Hashem in His eternal kindness grant us a yeshuah soon in our days.

34.title: Reflecting Upon a Miracle
34.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: CONTINUING GRATITUDE
items.he: אֲבָרֲכָה אֶת ה’ בְּכָל עֵת תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִי:
items.quote: I will bless Hashem at all times; His praise will always be in my mouth.
items.text: There should never be a time when you are not grateful to Him. You should feel that everything that you experience is miraculous.

items.title: THE SOURCE
items.he: בַּה’ תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי:
items.quote: My soul takes pride in Hashem.
items.text: Recognize that everything good that happens to you is from Hashem, the Source of all good. Take nothing for granted.

items.title: THE HUMBLE
items.he: יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ
items.quote: Let the humble people hear and be glad.
items.text: Share your feeling of joy and gratitude with those who are capable of suppressing their own pride to acknowledge their debt to Hashem.

items.title: GREATNESS
items.he: גַּדְּלוּ לַה’ אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו
items.quote: Declare the greatness of Hashem with me. Together let us recognize His Name as sublime.
items.text: The greatness of Hashem can best be recognized in a group of like-minded people who inspire each other with their enthusiasm.

items.title: SEEKING
items.he: דָּרַשְׁתִּי אֶת ה’ וְעָנָנִי וּמִכָּל מְגוּרוֹתַי הִצִּילָנִי
items.quote: I sought Hashem and He answered. He rescued me from all my terrors.
items.text: When you have a need of Hashem’s help, your primary focus should not be on your request but upon your relationship with Hashem. You should seek to be closer to Him and the solution to your problems will inevitably result.

items.title: SEEING THE LIGHT
items.he: הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ וּפְנֵיהֶם אַל יֶחְפָּרוּ
items.quote: Others have looked to Him and received light. Their faces were not shamed.
items.text: Don’t be discouraged at not feeling the closeness of Hashem. Just as others have looked to Hashem and were granted access to His light, so will you. You will not be disappointed if you are sincere.

items.title: POVERTY
items.he: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַה’ שָׁמֵעַ
items.quote: This poor man [David] called and Hashem heard.
items.text: No matter how successful you have been in life or how strong you are, when you approach Hashem think of yourself as abjectly poor. Everything you have is His. Without Him you have nothing and therefore you are totally dependent upon Him.

items.he: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה בּוֹ
items.quote: Fortunate is the man [of might] who takes refuge in Him.
items.text: He knows this might belongs to Hashem.

items.title: FEAR
items.he: חֹנֶה מַלְאַךְ ה’ סָבִיב לִירֵאָיו
items.quote: The angel of Hashem encamps [protectively] around those who fear Him.
items.text: As long as you fear only Hashem, He will see that you are protected. There is no reason to fear an attacker for he has no power to harm you unless it is the will of Hashem.

items.title: REALITY
items.he: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי טוֹב ה’
items.quote: Examine and see that Hashem is good.
items.text: Examine your experiences of life honestly and you will realize how good Hashem has been to you.

items.title: DEPRIVATION
items.he: יְראוּ אֶת ה’ קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָיו
items.quote: Fear Hashem, [you,] His holy ones. for there is no deprivation to those who fear Him.
items.text: Don’t be discouraged from living a holy life, for you will not suffer from deprivation.

items.he: כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי ה’ לֹא יַחְסְרוּ כָל טוֹב
items.quote: Young lions are in want and hunger, but those who seek Hashem will not lack any good.

items.title: COMING AND GOING
items.he: לְכוּ בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ לִי
items.quote: Come, children, listen to me.
items.text: To achieve a change in attitude you must go as well as come. You must go away from your defective thinking by recognizing its fallacies; then you will be open to new and better ideas.

items.he: יִרְאַת ה’ אֲלַמֶּדְכֶם
items.quote: I will teach you the fear of Hashem.
items.text: The fear of Hashem does not come to a person without effort. He must exert himself to give up his old attitude and learn a new attitude.

items.title: LIFE
items.he: מִי הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים
items.quote: Who is the man who wants life?
items.text: Everybody wants life but not everybody is willing to sacrifice his momentary desires to achieve the physical and spiritual health that are essential to long life in this world and the next.

items.title: DAYS
items.he: אֹהֵב יָמִים
items.quote: cherishes days.
items.text: You should aspire to cherish every day of your life, to utilize it to its full potential.

items.title: GOOD
items.he: לִרְאוֹת טוֹב
items.quote: seeing good.
items.text: You should aspire to cherish that which has true value in life, as opposed to material wealth that has only superficial value.

items.title: ON GUARD
items.he: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה
items.quote: Guard your tongue from evil, your lips from speaking deceit.
items.text: Your tongue and lips may be inclined to utter inappropriate words unthinkingly, as though they are acting independently of you. Your challenge is to control them and restrain them.

items.title: THE WRONG ROAD
items.he: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב
items.quote: Turn away from evil and do good.
items.text: Don’t assume that as long as you are not choosing an evil road, you are doing good. You may already be on the wrong road and evil is waiting for you somewhere along the way, unless you stop and examine your life.

items.title: PEACE
items.he: בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ
items.quote: Seek peace and pursue it.
items.text: It is not sufficient to avoid starting a dispute. You need to put your energy into identifying any situation which has the potential for dispute or where ill will among people already exists. Once you have identified such a situation you need to actively pursue strategies to overcome it.

items.title: EYES
items.he: עֵינֵי ה’ אֶל צַדִּיקִים
items.quote: The eyes of Hashem are toward the righteous.
items.text: Hashem sees everything in the universe, but His purpose in creating the world is fulfilled by what He sees in the the righteous.

items.title: HATZALAH AND YESHUAH
items.he: צָעֲקוּ וַה’ שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל צָרוֹתָם הִצִּילָם
items.quote: If they have cried out, He rescues them from all their troubles.
items.text: Hashem rescues the wicked who have cried out, but he reserves a yeshuah (salvation) for the humble tzadik, as it says in posuk 7, “And from all his troubles He saved him.” The difference is that yeshuah implies forming a bond or bris with the person being saved, whereas rescue (hatzalah) refers only to the act of recovery from distress.

items.he: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַה’ שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעוֹ
items.quote: This poor man [David] called and Hashem heard. And from all his troubles He saved him.

items.title: EYES
items.he: עֵינֵי ה’ אֶל צַדִּיקִים
items.quote: The eyes of Hashem are toward the righteous.
items.text: Hashem sees everything in the universe, but His purpose in creating the world is fulfilled by what He sees in the the righteous.

35.title: Searching for Self-Respect
35.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: BATTLE
items.he: רִיבָה ה’ אֶת יְרִיבַי לְחַם אֶת לֹחֲמָי
items.quote: Contend with my adversaries and fight my foes.
items.text: When you are confronted by enemies who seek to harm you, ask Hashem to act for you by defeating them. Even when you need to use the implements of war, it will be Hashem Who is actually wielding them.

items.he: הַחֲזֵק מָגֵן וְצִנָּה
items.quote: Hold a shield and armor [to protect me].

items.title: RESCUE
items.he: הָשִׁיבָה נַפְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶם מִכְּפִירִים יְחִידָתִי
items.quote: Rescue my soul from their darkness, my life from the young lions.
items.text: Save me from the cruelty and greed of my enemies.

items.title: WITHOUT CAUSE
items.he: כִּי חִנָּם טָמְנוּ לִי שַׁחַת רִשְׁתָּם חִנָּם חָפְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי
items.quote: For without cause they have concealed a pit [to kill] me with their net. Without cause they dug [a pit] to [destroy] my soul..
items.text: I have been the object of unfair and cruel treatment by those who hate me. I look to You to come to my aid and restore my life.

items.title: MOCKERY
items.he: וּבְצַלְעִי שָׂמְחוּ וְנֶאֱסָפוּ נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי
items.quote: But when I limped they were cheerful and gathered [to jeer me].
items.text: Instead of sympathy I was subjected to mockery. My overtures for peace were repaid with hatred.

items.he: כְּרֵעַ כְּאָח לִי הִתְהַלָּכְתִּי
items.quote: [When they were ill] I went about as for a good friend and as for my own brother.
items.text: Instead of sympathy I was subjected to mockery. My overtures for peace were repaid with hatred.

items.title: CONFIDENCE
items.he: תְּבוֹאֵהוּ שׁוֹאָה לֹא יֵדָע, וְרִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר טָמַן תִּלְכְּדוֹ, בְּשׁוֹאָה יִפָּל בָּהּ
items.quote: May a devastating darkness come upon each [of them] without warning. May his net which he concealed ensnare him. May he fall into it in the devastating darkness.
items.text: Restore your confidence in the victory against your enemies by visualizing their defeat.

items.title: REJOICING
items.he: וְנַפְשִׁי תָּגִיל בַּה’ תָּשִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ
items.quote: My soul will feel an intense gladness in Hashem. It will openly rejoice in His yeshuah.
items.text: Openly and joyfully declare your gratitude to Hashem for His yeshuah.

items.title: INTERVENTION
items.he: ה’ מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ
items.quote: Hashem, who is like You. You save the poor man from [the enemy who is] stronger than he.
items.text: Hashem intervenes in human affairs when necessary to protect the weak.

items.title: LAWS
items.he: וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלוֹ
items.quote: And [You save] the poor and the destitute from one who would rob him.
items.text: The Torah’s laws protect the poor from exploitation.

items.title: ACTION NOW
items.he: אֲדֹ־נָי כַּמָּה תִרְאֶה
items.quote: Hashem, how long will You look on?
items.text: Plead with Hashem to take action now.

items.he: רָאִיתָה ה’ אַל תֶּחֱרַשׁ אֲדֹ־נָי אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי
items.quote: You have seen, Hashem! Don’t be silent. O my L-rd, don’t be distant from me.

items.title: PRAISE
items.he: וּלְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקֶךָ כָּל הַיּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
items.quote: Hashem, my tongue will declare Your righteousness all day long with songs of praise.
items.text: Whenever the opportunity presents itself, praise the righteousness of Hashem’s laws and actions.

36.title: A Study in Contrasts
36.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: SELF-IDENTIFICATION
items.he: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד ה’ לְדָוִד
items.quote: For the musician, by David, servant of Hashem.
items.text: David could think of no nobler title than “servant of Hashem.” By choosing to identify himself with this title (rather than “king”) he extolled the virtues of humility and devotion. This is a lesson to all of us to live our lives in such a way that we can take pride in calling ourselves “servant of Hashem.”

items.raw: [36:2] WRONGDOER. – נְאֻם פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵין פַּחַד אֱלֹקִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו – “The words of transgression of the wrongdoer, [are known] within my heart. It is important that you understand the forces that affect the wrongdoer so that you can guard against them and influence others to do so.

items.title: KINDNESS AND FAITHFUNESS
items.he: ה’ בְּהַשָּׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ עַד שְׁחָקִים
items.quote: Hashem, Your kindness is unto the heavens. Your faithfulness is to the distant skies.
items.text: Because of His attribute of kindness Hashem sustains all living creatures. Because of His attribute of faithfulness Hashem assures the survival of mankind.

items.title: JUSTICE AND JUDGMENT
items.he: צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי אֵל מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה
items.quote: Your caring justice is like the mighty mountains. Your judgments are as the vast watery deep.
items.text: Because of His attribute of caring justice Hashem pays special attention to the welfare of deserving individuals. Because of His attribute of judgment Hashem demands accountability from all wrongdoers.

items.title: TRANSIENT KINDNESS
items.he: אָדָם וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִׁיעַ ה’
items.quote: You save both man and beast, Hashem.
items.text: In this world Hashem applies a universal attribute of kindness, which is meant for this world only.

items.title: ETERNAL KINDNESS
items.he: מַה יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹקִים וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ יֶחֱסָיוּן
items.quote: How precious is Your kindness, O G-d! And the children of man will take refuge in the shelter of Your wings.
items.text: In the next world we will witness Hashem’s attribute of eternal kindness, which is meant for those who are worthy.

items.he: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּשֶׁן בֵּיתֶךָ וְנַחַל עֲדָנֶיךָ תַשְׁקֵם
items.quote: They will receive their fill from the abundance of Your house. And from the stream of Your delights You will give them to drink.

items.he: כִּי עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה אוֹר
items.quote: For with You is the source of life. In Your light may we be permitted to see the light [of eternal life].

items.title: SPECIAL GRANT
items.he: מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵב
items.quote: Extend Your kindness into this world to those who know You. And, extend Your caring judgment to the upright of heart.
items.text: Ask Hashem to extend His special kindness into this world and grant you protection from evil so that you can serve Him as you would like.

notes: This verse is recited during the daily ritual of donning a talis. This garment with its mitzvah of tzitzis symbolizes Hashem’s protection, which corresponds to the protection from the elements that a garment provides. This protection is expressed in 36:8 as “the shelter of Your wings”. The kindness of Hashem is mentioned in 36:11 as being “extended” into this world. This corresponds to the way a tent is extended over a person to give him shelter and the way the talis is extended over a person when he first puts it on. The mention of light in 36:10 may also be significant, because the key aspect of the mitzvah of tzitzis is that we see them. That’s why there is no mitzvah of tzitzis at night.

37.title: A Tapestry of Enlightenment
37.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: ENVY
items.he: אַל תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה
items.quote: Don’t be disturbed by bad people. Don’t be envious of wrongdoers.
items.text: Don’t let yourself be tempted to associate with wrongdoers and emulate them because of their apparent good fortune. It won’t last.

items.he: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלוּן
items.quote: For like grass they will be quickly cut down. Like vegetation they will wither.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: בְּטַח בַּה’ וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב שְׁכָן אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה
items.quote: Trust in Hashem and do good. Dwell in the land and nourish [your] faith.
items.text: Maintain your trust in Hashem despite difficulties; you will be rewarded with security and happiness.

items.title: DELIGHT
items.he: וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל ה’ וְיִתֶּן לְךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת לִבֶּךָ
items.quote: Delight in Hashem. He will grant you the desires of your heart.
items.text: Serve Hashem with joy in your heart, for you are pleasing Him.

items.title: RESENTMENT
items.he: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל תִּתְחַר אַךְ לְהָרֵעַ
items.quote: Let go of anger and forsake resentment. Don’t let yourself be disturbed, for [such feelings] bring only harm.
items.text: You will only harm yourself if you indulge in anger and resentment. If you focus on what is good in your life, your attitude will be its own reward.

items.title: THE FUTURE
items.he: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב וּשְׁכֹן לְעוֹלָם
items.quote: Turn away from evil and do good. You will then live [in peace] all your life.
items.text: Hold fast to your principles in spite of difficulties and you will be able to look ahead to a fulfilled life.

items.title: INTEGRITY
items.he: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם
items.quote: The evildoer borrows but does not repay.
items.text: Don’t borrow unless you really need to; if you have borrowed, treat your debt as a holy obligation.

items.title: GENEROSITY
items.he: וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵן
items.quote: but the righteous person is a benefactor and a giver.
items.text: Be generous and helpful to others, without undue concern about being reimbursed.

items.title: LOVE OF THE RIGHTEOUS
items.he: מֵה’ מִצְעֲדֵי גֶבֶר כּוֹנָנוּ וְדַרְכּוֹ יֶחְפָּץ
items.quote: From Hashem the righteous man’s footsteps are made firm and Hashem is pleased with his way.
items.text: Even though the righteous man may seem to be at a disadvantage in this world, Hashem loves him and supports him every step of his way through life.

items.title: YESHUAH
items.he: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵה’ מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה
items.quote: The yeshuah of the righteous is from Hashem, their stronghold in time of distress.
items.text: The future of the righteous is assured because their yeshuah is a certain promise from Him.

38.title: A Tefillah for Recovery
38.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: MEMORIES
items.he: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר
items.quote: By David, to call to mind [a severe illness].
items.text: Recall the sufferings of the past from time to time and take to heart the lessons you learned from the experience.

items.title: INTROSPECTION
items.he: ה’ אַל בְּקֶצְפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וּבַחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי
items.quote: Hashem, do not rebuke me in Your anger nor chastise me in Your fury.
items.text: If you are suffering severe illness or pain, search your heart and ask yourself what sin you might have committed to warrant the anger of Hashem.

items.he: אֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵי זַעְמֶךָ אֵין שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמַי מִפְּנֵי חַטָּאתִי
items.quote: There is no whole place on my body because of Your rage, no soundness of limbs because of my offense.

items.title: CONFESSION
items.he: כִּי עֲוֹנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּנִּי
items.quote: For my sins have risen over my head. Like a heavy load, they are too heavy for me.
items.text: When you confess your sins, let each sin remind you of all the others. Don’t be easy on yourself but acknowledge all your failings. Then Hashem will forgive you.

items.title: REGRET
items.he: כִּי עֲוֹנִי אַגִּיד אֶדְאַג מֵחַטָּאתִי
items.quote: For I admit my iniquity; I worry because of my sin.
items.text: When you admit your sin, the fact that you offended your Creator and that you have distanced yourself from Him should weigh heavily upon you. You should ask yourself how you could have been so foolish.

items.title: DEPRESSION
items.he: נַעֲוֵיתִי שַׁחֹתִי עַד מְאֹד כָּל הַיּוֹם קֹדֵר הִלָּכְתִּי
items.quote: I am bent and very stooped over. All day long I go about in a black depression.
items.text: If your troubles have brought you down and your mood is depressed, acknowledge you feelings to Hashem and He will surely comfort you.

items.title: ASPIRATION
items.he: אֲדֹ־נָי נֶגְדְּךָ כָל תַּאֲוָתִי וְאַנְחָתִי מִמְּךָ לֹא נִסְתָּרָה
items.quote: My Lord, before You is all my aspiration. My sighing is not concealed from You.
items.text: Recall your hopes of being close to Hashem, the relationship which you have sadly lost. Recall your yearning to be able see Him once again as the complete Master of your life and recall the happiness which you once found, but hope to regain again.

items.he: אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי ה’ אֱלֹקַי אַל תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי
items.quote: Don’t forsake me, O Hashem, my G-d. Be not far from me.

39.title: A Crisis of Conscience
39.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: RESTRAINT
items.he: אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי
items.quote: I resolved to watch my attitude and avoid sinning with my tongue. I would keep my mouth muzzled.
items.text: Follow David’s example and restrain your natural tendency to feel resentful about the difficulties you encounter in life. Hashem has sent those difficulties to you for a purpose.

items.he: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי דוּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מִטּוֹב וּכְאֵבִי נֶעְכָּר
items.quote: I became mute, totally silent. I kept quiet [even] from good though my pain was intense.

items.he: הָשַׁע מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְאֵינֶנִּי
items.quote: Release me and let me recover before I depart and I am no more.

items.title: PERSPECTIVE
items.he: הִנֵּה טְפָחוֹת נָתַתָּה יָמַי, וְחֶלְדִּי כְאַיִן נֶגְדֶּךָ
items.quote: Behold, You have set my days in handbreadths. My life span is insignificant before You.
items.text: If your difficulties are making you feel desperate and frustrated, curb your resentment by putting your situation in perspective. Realize how insignificant you are in the vastness of Creation. Don’t feel that you have a right to a pleasant situation in life because of who you are.

items.he: כִּי גֵר אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ תּוֹשָׁב כְּכָל אֲבוֹתָי
items.quote: For I am a sojourner before You, a temporary resident like all my forefathers.

items.title: WEALTH
items.he: אִישׁ אַךְ הֶבֶל יֶהֱמָיוּן יִצְבֹּר וְלֹא יֵדַע מִי אֹסְפָם
items.quote: [Man’s] hectic activity is but futility. He accumulates, but he does not know who will gather them in.
items.text: Don’t focus your energy and resources on gathering wealth. It won’t last and your efforts will have been wasted. Any wealth you assemble is insignificant in the overall scheme of things.

items.title: RENEWAL
items.he: עַתָּה מַה קִּוִּיתִי אֲדֹ־נָי תּוֹחַלְתִּי לְךָ הִיא
items.quote: And now, for what do I hope, O Master? My yearning is to You.
items.text: Realize that expectations of gratification in this world are misplaced. The ultimate meaning of life is not physical, but spiritual, and so you should yearn for fulfillment through bonding with your Creator.

items.title: APPEAL TO BE HEARD
items.he: שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי ה’ וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל דִּמְעָתִי אַל תֶּחֱרַשׁ
items.quote: Hear my prayer, Hashem, and give ear to my outcry; don’t be silent to my tears.
items.text: Ask Hashem to listen to your tefillah respond to your heartfelt emotions.

items.title: FORGIVENESS
items.he: מִכָּל פְּשָׁעַי הַצִּילֵנִי
items.quote: Rescue me from all my transgressions.
items.text: Ask Hashem to forgive your transgressions and rescue you from being caught up in their consequences.

items.title: HEALING
items.he: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי נִגְעֶךָ מִתִּגְרַת יָדְךָ אֲנִי כָלִיתִי
items.quote: Take Your affliction from me; I am completely devastated by the assault of Your hand.
items.text: Ask Hashem to heal your affliction for it has already accomplished its purpose.

40.title: Sincerity in Tefillah
40.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: PERSONAL EXPERIENCE
items.he: קַוֹּה קִוִּיתִי ה’ וַיֵּט אֵלַי וַיִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעָתִי
items.quote: I continued to put my hope in Hashem. He leaned down toward me and heard my cry.
items.text: Encourage others by recounting occasions in which He responded to your tefillos by coming to your aid.

items.he: וַיַּעֲלֵנִי מִבּוֹר שָׁאוֹן מִטִּיט הַיָּוֵן
items.quote: He raised me from a black pit, from the clinging mire.

items.title: A NEW SONG
items.he: וַיִּתֵּן בְּפִי שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּה לֵאלֹקֵינוּ
items.quote: He has put a new song in my mouth, of praise to our G-d.
items.text: Use the power of song to praise Hashem and inspire people to revere Him.

items.title: MAJESTY IN NUMBERS
items.he: בִּשַּׂרְתִּי צֶדֶק בְּקָהָל רָב
items.quote: I have proclaimed [Your] benevolence in a great assembly.
items.text: Participate in large gatherings to maximize the glory and awareness of Hashem.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר שָׂם ה’ מִבְטַחוֹ
items.quote: Fortunate is the man who put his trust in Hashem.
items.text: Trust in Hashem and not in smooth-talking people who claim they can solve your problems.

items.he: וְלֹא פָנָה אֶל רְהָבִים וְשָׂטֵי כָזָב
items.quote: He wisely did not turn to the braggarts that turn away deceitfully when there is trouble.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.he: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֲדֹ־נָי יַחֲשָׁב לִי
items.quote: As for me, I am poor and destitute, [yet] my L-rd treats me as important.
items.text: Even though you have been granted public honors, you should see yourself as poor and destitute because everything you have comes from Hashem.

items.title: WONDERS
items.he: רַבּוֹת עָשִׂיתָ אַתָּה ה’ אֱלֹקַי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ אֵלֵינוּ
items.quote: You have done many great things. You, Hashem, my G-d [have performed] Your wonders and Your plans for us.
items.text: Praise Hashem for the wonders He has performed to save Klal Yisrael.

items.he: אַגִּידָה וַאֲדַבֵּרָה עָצְמוּ מִסַּפֵּר
items.quote: Were I to tell others or speak, [I would fail, as] they are too numerous to recount.

items.title: SINCERITY
items.he: זֶבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא חָפַצְתָּ
items.quote: You did not want a korban shelamim or a korban minchah.
items.text: It is not enough to go through the motions of saying tefillos and doing mitzvos. Hashem will not be pleased unless your actions are accompanied by a measure of devotion and sincerity.

items.he: לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹקַי חָפָצְתִּי
items.quote: My G-d, it has been my desire to carry out Your will.

items.he: וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי
items.quote: Your Torah has not just been on my lips, but within my innards.

items.title: URGENCY
items.he: רְצֵה ה’ לְהַצִּילֵנִי ה’ לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה
items.quote: May it be Your will, Hashem, to save me. Hashem, hurry to my assistance.
items.text: Express your plea to be saved with urgency. This emphasizes how dependent you are on Hashem’s yeshuah.

items.he: עֶזְרָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה אֱלֹקַי אַל תְּאַחַר
items.quote: You are my Help and my Rescuer; my G-d, do not delay.

41.title: In Praise of the Caregiver
41.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: SENSITIVITY
items.he: אַשְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּיל אֶל דָּל
items.quote: Praises to the giver of understanding care to the invalid.
items.text: When you care for an invalid, you should be sensitive to his needs. This is a great mitzvah.

items.he: בְּיוֹם רָעָה יְמַלְּטֵהוּ ה’
items.quote: On the day of evil, [console the patient by telling him that surely] Hashem will save him.

items.title: CONCERN
items.he: ה’ יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ וִיחַיֵּהוּ
items.quote: [Pray] that Hashem will protect [the patient] and give him life.
items.text: Show your concern for an invalid and help him by praying to Hashem for his recovery.

items.title: HEALING
items.he: ה’ חָנֵּנִי רְפָאָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי חָטָאתִי לָךְ
items.quote: Hashem, have pity on me! Heal my soul for I have sinned against You!
items.text: When you ask Hashem to heal your illness, acknowledge your sins against Him. In that way you will demonstrate that the purpose of your suffering has been served and the time has come for healing.

items.title: BLESSED
items.he: בָּרוּךְ ה’ אֱלֹקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן
items.quote: Blessed is Hashem, the G-d of Yisrael from [the beginning of] the World to the [Next] World, Amen and Amen.
items.text: May Hashem’s blessings of kindness continue to flow throughout space and time.

42.title: Yearning for Redemption
42.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: YEARNING
items.he: כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל אֲפִיקֵי מָיִם כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹקִים
items.quote: As the deer cries out for springs of water, so my soul cries out for You, O G-d.
items.text: Visualize the life-giving flow of fresh water to enhance your spiritual experience of bonding with Hashem.

items.he: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹקִים לְאֵ־ל חָי
items.quote: My soul thirsts for G-d, for the living G-d.

items.raw: [42:4] TEARS. – הָיְתָה לִּי דִמְעָתִי לֶחֶם יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה – My tears have been [my] bread, day and by night.” Ask Hashem to let the bitter experience of being taunted by wicked people serve as a penance for your sins.

items.he: כָּל מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ וְגַלֶּיךָ עָלַי עָבָרוּ
items.quote: All Your breakers and Your waves have swept over me.

items.title: PAINFUL MEMORY
items.he: כִּי אֶעֱבֹר בַּסָּךְ אֶדַּדֵּם עַד בֵּית אֱלֹקִים
items.quote: how I used to pass along in the [stately] throng, proceeding slowly to the House of G-d.
items.text: Develop your yearning for the Geulah by visualizing the spectacle of the orderly procession through the gates of Yerushalayim in ancient times.

items.title: COMFORT
items.he: מַה תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹקִים
items.quote: Why are you downcast, my soul, and confused within me? Wait and look to G-d!
items.text: Work on yourself to restore your optimism and have faith that the Geulah will surely come.

43.title: A Bright Future
43.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: DEFENSE
items.he: מִגּוֹי לֹא חָסִיד שָׁפְטֵנִי אֱלֹקִים וְרִיבָה רִיבִי
items.quote: Grant me justice, O G-d. Take up my struggle against a nation that does not practice humane principles.
items.text: When you are confronted by cruel enemies who seek to harm you, ask Hashem to act for you by defeating them.

items.title: LIBERATION
items.he: מֵאִישׁ מִרְמָה וְעַוְלָה תְפַלְּטֵנִי
items.quote: Liberate me from a man of deceit and injustice.
items.text: When you are being victimized by an unscrupulous individual, ask Hashem to frustrate his evil intentions.

items.title: STRENGTH
items.he: כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹקֵי מָעוּזִּי לָמָה זְנַחְתָּנִי
items.quote: For You are the G-d of my strength. Why have You forsaken me?
items.text: Declare your continued reliance upon Hashem and ask Him to restore His closeness to you.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.he: שְׁלַח אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ הֵמָּה יַנְחוּנִי
items.quote: Send Your light and Your truth. They will guide me.
items.text: Look for Hashem’s guidance, based upon the light of the Torah.

items.title: DELIGHT
items.he: וְאָבוֹאָה אֶל מִזְבַּח אֱלֹקִים אֶל קֵ־ל שִׂמְחַת גִּילִי
items.quote: I will then come to the altar of G-d, to G-d, the joy of my delight.
items.text: – Visualize your delight in restoring your closeness with Hashem.

items.title: COMFORT
items.he: מַה תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹקִים
items.quote: Why are you downcast, my soul, and confused within me? Wait and look to G-d!
items.text: Work on yourself to restore your optimism and have faith that your Geulah will surely come.

44.title: Triumph and Tragedy
44.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: TRADITION
items.he: אֱלֹקִים בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ לָנוּ
items.quote: G-d, we have heard with our [own] ears. Our forefathers, have related to us.
items.text: Strengthen Your emunah (faith) by recalling that the events of the past did not occur in a vacuum. Their history was passed down to from father to son, from generation to generation.

items.title: DIVINE ACTION
items.he: אַתָּה יָדְךָ גּוֹיִם הוֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵם תָּרַע לְאֻמִּים וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם
items.quote: You, [with] Your own hand, drove out [seven sinful] nations and planted [our forefathers in the Land of Canaan.
items.text: Renew your conviction that we committed no offense in taking possession of Eretz Canaan. It was Hashem who replaced the Canaanim because of their corrupt ways.

items.title: STRENGTH
items.he: אַתָּה הוּא מַלְכִּי אֱלֹקִים צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעוֹת יַעֲקֹב
items.quote: You have been my King, O G-d, command [Your malachim to carry out] yeshuos for Yaakov.
items.text: Ask Hashem to invoke His traditional bond with the Jewish people and save them from their enemies, even if that yeshuah is carried out by intermediaries rather than the direct hand of G-d.

items.he: כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ הֱבִישׁוֹתָ
items.quote: For You have saved us [in the past] from our tormentors and You shamed those who hate us.

items.title: URGENCY
items.he: קוּמָה עֶזְרָתָה לָּנוּ וּפְדֵנוּ לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ
items.quote: Arise to Help us! Redeem us because of Your kindness.
items.text: Ask Hashem not to wait any longer, but to bring the yeshuah now. It is urgently needed.

items.title: THANKING FOR PAST GLORIES
items.he: בֵּאלֹקִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל הַיּוֹם וְשִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם נוֹדֶה סֶלָה
items.quote: G-d has given us a sense of glory all the days, and we have always thanked Your Name, Selah.
items.text: Continue to thank Hashem for the past glories of our nation.

items.title: ABANDONMENT
items.he: אַף זָנַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵנוּ
items.quote: [But now] You have also cast us off and humiliated us.
items.text: Ask Hashem to restore His closeness to you.

items.he: תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אָחוֹר מִנִּי צָר
items.quote: You have turned us back [in retreat] from the tormentor.

items.title: ABANDONMENT
items.he: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָשָׁל בַּגּוֹיִם מְנוֹד רֹאשׁ בַּלְאֻמִּים
items.quote: You made us a [tragic] symbol among the nations, [a reason] among the peoples [for] shaking [their] head.
items.text: Our humiliation is all the worse because it was imposed through the actions of Hashem and therefore symbolizes how He has distanced Himself from us.

45.title: A Royal Marriage
45.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: SPEECH CONTROL
items.he: לְשׁוֹנִי עֵט סוֹפֵר מָהִיר
items.quote: My tongue is [like the] pen of a skillful scribe.
items.text: When you speak, choose your words carefully to say what you really mean, as though you were writing them for posterity.

items.title: MORALE BOOST
items.he: עַל כֵּן בֵּרַכְךָ אֱלֹקִים לְעוֹלָם
items.quote: Therefore, G-d has blessed you throughout your life.
items.text: Through carefully chosen words, boost the morale and give encouragement to a young couple entering marriage..

items.title: PREPARATION FOR LIFE
items.he: חֲגוֹר חַרְבְּךָ עַל יָרֵךְ גִּבּוֹר הוֹדְךָ וַהֲדָרֶךָ
items.quote: Gird your sword upon [your] thigh, O mighty warrior. [Victory for Torah and truth will be] your triumph and your glory.
items.text: Prepare yourself for the responsibilities of building a home by learning Torah.

items.title: GARBED IN GOODNESS
items.he: מֹר וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת כָּל בִּגְדֹתֶיךָ
items.quote: [The fragrance of] myrrh, aloes, and cassia, [pervades] all your garments.
items.text: Let your middos and good deeds be like sweet smelling clothing that enhances your physical body.

items.title: HISTORY
items.he: אַזְכִּירָה שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל דֹּר וָדֹר
items.quote: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations.
items.text: Make a contribution to the world that Hashem created. Try to live your life so that it will be sufficiently worthy to be remembered by succeeding generations.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.he: וְעַנְוָה צֶדֶק וְתוֹרְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת יְמִינֶךָ
items.quote: Righteous humility at your right hand will teach you awesome things.
items.text: Live your life with humility, rejecting deception, falsehood, and pride.

items.title: TRUTH
items.he: כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹקִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד
items.quote: Your throne is [the truth that comes from the throne] of G-d, which is eternal.
items.text: In building and administering your home let your guideline always be the truth of G-d.

items.he: שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶךָ
items.quote: A scepter of integrity is the scepter of your kingdom.

items.title: LISTEN
items.he: שִׁמְעִי בַת וּרְאִי וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ
items.quote: Hear, O daughter, and see. Incline your ear.
items.text: Be receptive to the wisdom of those who preceded you. Don’t be confused by youthful fantasies.

items.title: SIMPLE LIVING
items.he: וּבַת צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ עֲשִׁירֵי עָם
items.quote: [Don’t be seduced by] the power of temptation bearing a gift [of worldly luxury], sought by the richest of the nation.
items.text: Don’t be misled by the seductive temptations of luxury.

items.title: TRUE FULFILLMENT
items.he: כָּל כְּבוּדָּה בַת מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה
items.quote: The entire glory of the princess is within her home.
items.text: Your true fulfillment is not to be found in the false sophistication of society or material wealth.

items.title: WORTHY CHILDREN
items.he: תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ יִהְיוּ בָנֶיךָ
items.quote: May your sons be [worthy of stepping] into the place of your fathers.
items.text: Ask Hashem to bless you with worthy children that are able and willing to be living links in the chain of Torah tradition.

46.title: From Turbulence to Tranquility
46.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: CATACLYSM
items.he: אֱלֹקִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹד
items.quote: G-d [will be] our shelter and strength. [His] help with troubles [will be] very quickly forthcoming.
items.text: When faced with cataclysmic events in nature, such as earthquakes and floods, you should maintain your peace of mind, for Hashem is your shelter.

items.he: עַל כֵּן לֹא נִירָא בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ וּבְמוֹט הָרִים בְּלֵב יַמִּים
items.quote: Therefore, we will not be afraid when He transforms the earth, when mountains tip over into the midst of the seas.

items.title: YERUSHALAYIM
items.he: נָהָר פְּלָגָיו יְשַׂמְּחוּ עִיר אֱלֹקִים קְדֹשׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן
items.quote: [There is a] river. Its streams will make the City of G-d rejoice, the holiest of the dwelling places of the Most High.
items.text: In the face of world turbulence you should be calmed by your bitachon that when the Geulah comes, a river of spiritual peace and serenity will flow from the Bais Hamikdash throughout the world.

items.he: אֱלֹקִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ בַּל תִּמּוֹט יַעְזְרֶהָ אֱלֹקִים לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר
items.quote: G-d [will be] in its midst, it will not be toppled. G-d will help it towards the dawn.
items.text: As the dawn of the Geulah approaches, even if there is destruction all around, Yerushalayim will be protected.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: ה’ צְבָא־וֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָנוּ אֱלֹקֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה
items.quote: Hashem, Master of Legions, is with us. [He is a] stronghold for us, the G-d of Yaakov, Selah.
items.text: Be confident in the permanent bond that Hashem has with the Jewish people.

items.title: CONCEALMENT
items.he: עַל עֲלָמוֹת שִׁיר
items.quote: A song [to be accompanied on the instrument called] alamos (concealment).
items.text: While the direct influence of Hashem upon world events is hidden from us, the time will come that everything will be clear.

items.title: WAR
items.he: לְכוּ חֲזוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת ה’ אֲשֶׁר שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת בָּאָרֶץ
items.quote: Come and reflect upon the acts of Hashem for He has made a cataclysm in the earth.
items.text: Hashem will reveal His power when He wages victorious war against those powerful nations who seek to destroy the tiny nation of Yisrael.

items.title: PEACE
items.he: מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת עַד קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ
items.quote: He cancels wars to the end of the earth.
items.text: Hashem will cancel war for all mankind because everyone will be united in devotion to Him.

items.raw: [46:11]. הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי אָנֹכִי אֱלֹקִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ – “[Desist [from wars] and know that I am G-d. I shall be exalted among the nations. I shall be exalted upon the [entire] earth.”

47.title: The Shofar is Calling
47.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: ACKNOWLEDGING THE KING
items.he: כָּל הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹקִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה
items.quote: All nations, clap your hands! Sing out to G-d with a joyful cry!
items.text: Let all nations join us in acknowledging Hashem as King over mankind.

items.he: כִּי ה’ עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל כָּל הָאָרֶץ
items.quote: Hashem is the Most High. [His power is] awesome. [He is the] great King over all the earth.

items.title: APPRECIATION
items.he: זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹקִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ
items.quote: Sing to G-d with music, sing! Sing to our King, sing!
items.text: Let all nations join us in loyal devotion and enthusiastic appreciation of Hashem’s kindness to His creatures.

items.he: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹקִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל
items.quote: For G-d is King of all the world. Sing, with meaning!

items.title: RECOGNITION
items.he: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹקֵי אַבְרָהָם
items.quote: The virtuous nobles among the nations have gathered [to acknowledge] the people of Avraham’s G-d.
items.text: There will be universal recognition of the essential benefit that Yisrael has brought to the world.

items.title: THE SHOFAR
items.he: עָלָה אֱלֹקִים בִּתְרוּעָה ה’ בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר
items.quote: G-d [Elokim] ascended with the teruah blast, [the Name of] Hashem, with the sound of the shofar.
items.text: Hashem’s Name of loving mercy is ascending with the steady, calming tekiah sound of the shofar.

48.title: The City of Glory
48.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: PRAISED
items.he: גָּדוֹל ה’ וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, בְּעִיר אֱלֹקֵינוּ הַר קָדְשׁוֹ
items.quote: Great is Hashem and [He is] most acclaimed in the city of our G-d, His holy mountain.
items.text: Yerushalayim is the place where the greatness of Hashem as Master of the universe is most clearly perceived. It is there that the intensity of His presence is most felt and so it is there that Hashem is seen as truly great.

items.he: יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל הָאָרֶץ
items.quote: [Yerushalayim is] beautiful in its setting, the joy of all the land.

items.title: DISPLAY OF POWER
items.he: בְּרוּחַ קָדִים תְּשַׁבֵּר אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ
items.quote: [It was like the] east wind [with which] You smashed the ships of Tarshish.
items.text: Hashem will stop the attackers of Yerushalayim as though they had been struck by a catastrophic east wind.

items.he: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ כֵּן רָאִינוּ, בְּעִיר ה’ צְבָא־וֹת בְּעִיר אֱלֹקֵינוּ אֱלֹקִים
items.quote: Just as we heard, so did we see in the city of Hashem, Master of Legions, in the city of our G-d.

items.title: KINDNESS
items.he: דִּמִּינוּ אֱלֹקִים חַסְדֶּךָ בְּקֶרֶב הֵיכָלֶךָ
items.quote: We hoped, O G-d, for Your kindness in the midst of Your Sanctuary.
items.text: We continue to have bitachon that in Hashem’s kindness He will protect us.

items.title: STERN JUSTICE
items.he: כְּשִׁמְךָ אֱלֹקִים כֵּן תְּהִלָּתְךָ עַל קַצְוֵי אֶרֶץ
items.quote: Just as Your Name is Elokim, so is Your praise to the ends of the earth.
items.text: He metes out stern justice to the enemies of Yerushalayim.

items.title: RIGHTEOUS JUSTICE
items.he: צֶדֶק מָלְאָה יְמִינֶךָ
items.quote: Righteous justice fills Your right hand.
items.text: He defends and protects Yerushalayim.

items.title: JOY
items.he: יִשְׂמַח הַר צִיּוֹן, תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה, לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ
items.quote: Har Tzion rejoices and the ‘daughters’ of Yehudah (surrounding towns), are delighted because of Your judgments.
items.text: The people of Yerushalayim express their gratitude.

items.title: DEVOTION
items.he: כִּי זֶה אֱלֹקִים אֱלֹקֵינוּ עוֹלָם וָעֶד, הוּא יְנַהֲגֵנוּ עַל מוּת
items.quote: This is G-d, our G-d, forever and ever, He will guide us beyond death.
items.text: Our devotion to Hashem is felt most intensely in Yerushalayim.

49.title: Priorities
49.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: TRANSITORY LIFE
items.he: הַאֲזִינוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵי חָלֶד
items.quote: Incline your ear all who dwell in this transitory world.
items.text: Remember that this world is transitory and whatever material things you build up here have no permanence.

items.he: לָמָּה אִירָא בִּימֵי רָע עֲוֹן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּנִי
items.quote: Why should I [devote myself to material wealth because I] fear bad times? The sin [following] on my heels will surround me.
items.text: Your true protection is Hashem. The only thing you really have to fear is sin.

items.he: אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֹא יָבִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ
items.quote: Even with [wealth and] honor, [if] a man does not understand, he is comparable to the animals that fall silent.

items.title: TIME FOR TESHUVAH
items.he: וְיֵקַר פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם וְחָדַל לְעוֹלָם
items.quote: The redemption of their soul [for money] is unattainable. [After death, repentance] is ended forever.
items.text: Do teshuvah (repentance) for your sins now because you will not be able to do so after you die.

items.title: BEYOND THE GRAVE
items.he: אַךְ אֱלֹקִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי סֶלָה
items.quote: But, may G-d redeem my soul from the power of the grave. May He take me [to Him for eternal life], Selah!
items.text: Ask that your teshuvah will be accepted and you will have life beyond the grave.

50.title: Preparing for Judgment
50.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: THE UNIVERSAL G-D
items.he: ה’ דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא אָרֶץ מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד מְבֹאוֹ
items.quote: Hashem has spoken, summoning the inhabited world, from the rising of the sun to its setting.
items.text: All of mankind without exception is subject to the rule of G-d.

items.title: THE PRESENCE OF G-D
items.he: מִצִּיּוֹן מִכְלַל יֹפִי אֱלֹקִים הוֹפִיעַ
items.quote: Out of Tzion, epitome of beauty, G-d appeared.
items.text: Although Hashem pervades the entire universe, His most intense Presence is associated with Yerushalayim.

items.title: FIRE AND WIND
items.he: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֹּאכֵל וּסְבִיבָיו נִשְׂעֲרָה מְאֹד
items.quote: a consuming fire before Him, surrounded with an intense storm-wind.
items.text: The unlimited power of Hashem may be symbolized in human terms by the images of fire and wind.

items.title: HEAVEN AND EARTH
items.he: יִקְרָא אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל וְאֶל הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּוֹ
items.quote: He summons the heavens above and the earth so that He may judge His people.
items.text: Hashem summons heaven and earth to bear witness when Yisrael is being judged.

items.title: RIGHTEOUS JUDGMENT
items.he: וַיַּגִּידוּ שָׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ כִּי אֱלֹקִים שֹׁפֵט הוּא סֶלָה
items.quote: The heavens proclaim His righteousness, for G-d is the Judge.
items.text: The heavens which outlast human history can see that the judgment of Hashem is true and fair. Thus, they are called upon to proclaim His righteousness.

items.title: EMPTY RITES
items.he: לֹא עַל זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶיךָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד
items.quote: I will not be rebuking you for your sacrifices, for your burnt-offerings [have been] continually before me.
items.text: Hashem is not concerned with empty rites, even when they fulfill the requirements. He wants your sincere confession of sin and teshuvah.

items.he: זְבַח לֵאלֹקִים תּוֹדָה וְשַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶיךָ
items.quote: Offer to God confession. Then, fulfill your vows to the Most High.

items.he: זֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה יְכַבְּדָנְנִי וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְאֶנּוּ בְּיֵשַׁע אֱלֹקִים
items.quote: [The one who] brings a sacrificial offering of confession, honors Me. If he sets [an upright] way, I will show him the yeshuah of G-d.

items.title: EMPTY LEARNING
items.he: מַה לְּךָ לְסַפֵּר חֻקָּי וַתִּשָּׂא בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי פִיךָ
items.quote: Why do you recite My laws? And carry My covenant in your mouth?
items.text: Hashem wants the learning of Torah to be internalized and honored with action.

items.he: אַתָּה שָׂנֵאתָ מוּסָר וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ דְּבָרַי אַחֲרֶיךָ
items.quote: You have detested mussar. You threw My words behind you.

51.title: Beyond Teshuvah
51.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: FORGIVENESS
items.he: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹקִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ מְחֵה פְשָׁעָי
items.quote: O G-d, grant me favor [and forgive my sins] as befitting Your kindness. And as befits the abundance of Your compassion, erase my transgressions.
items.text: Ask Hashem to forgive your sins out of compassion, even though you feel that you don’t deserve it.

items.he: הֵן בְּעָווֹן חוֹלָלְתִּי
items.quote: Indeed, I was fashioned in iniquity.
items.text: Ask for compassion because the tendency to sin is inherent in the human condition.

items.title: PURIFICATION
items.he: הֶרֶב כַּבְּסֵנִי מֵעֲוֹנִי וּמֵחַטָּאתִי טַהֲרֵנִי
items.quote: Cleanse me thoroughly from my iniquity and purify me from my sin.
items.text: Ask Hashem to restore your sensitivity to sin so that you will more readily recognize sinful temptations in the future. Let your cleansing be like soap that washes away a stain.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.he: תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב וְאֶטְהָר תְּכַבְּסֵנִי וּמִשֶּׁלֶג אַלְבִּין
items.quote: Purge me of sin with hyssop. Then I shall be pure. Wash me and I shall be whiter than snow.
items.text: On asking to be purified of sin, express deep humility (symbolized by the hyssop), with a broken heart as your offering to Hashem.

items.he: זִבְחֵי אֱלֹקִים רוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה לֵב נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹקִים לֹא תִבְזֶה
items.quote: The sacrifices for G-d are a broken spirit. O G-d, You don’t spurn a heart that is broken and contrite.

items.title: CONFESSION
items.he: כִּי פְשָׁעַי אֲנִי אֵדָע וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד
items.quote: For I have come to recognize my transgressions. And my sin is always before me.
items.text: Humbly admit that you have sinned and express your deep regret.

items.title: ACCEPTANCE
items.he: לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ תִּזְכֶּה בְשָׁפְטֶךָ
items.quote: Therefore, You are just in holding me guilty. You are right in Your judgment.
items.text: If you are experiencing physical distress or danger, accept the justice of your punishment. If the purpose of your suffering has been served, Hashem will give you relief.

items.title: RESOLVE
items.he: הֵן אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת וּבְסָתֻם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵנִי
items.quote: Nevertheless, You have wanted truth in my covered parts and in my concealed heart You teach me wisdom.
items.text: Ask Hashem for help in arousing your conscience and your will to enable you to overcome your human weaknesses in the future.

items.title: RESOLVE
items.he: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא לִי אֱלֹקִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי
items.quote: Create a pure heart for me, O G-d, and renew a firm spirit within me.

items.title: JOY
items.he: תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה
items.quote: Make me hear joy and happiness.
items.text: Ask Hashem to grant you the joy of being free of sin once more.

items.title: ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
items.he: לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ חָטָאתִי וְהָרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי
items.quote: I have sinned against You alone. I did what was evil in Your eyes.
items.text: Examine yourself to acknowledge a hidden sin. Even if the world is not aware of it, you have sinned against Hashem and have undermined your relationship with Him.

items.title: RESTORATION
items.he: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ
items.quote: Don’t discard me from Your presence.
items.text: Ask Hashem to restore His relationship with you and not to treat you as repugnant to Him.

items.he: הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ
items.quote: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.he: אֲלַמְּדָה פֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ וְחַטָּאִים אֵלֶיךָ יָשׁוּבוּ
items.quote: I will teach Your ways to transgressors and sinners will return to You.
items.text: If you have the opportunity, use the insight you have gained to give guidance to others.

items.title: RESCUE AND PRAISE
items.he: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱלֹקִים אֱלֹקֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי תְּרַנֵּן לְשׁוֹנִי צִדְקָתֶךָ
items.quote: Rescue me from blood-guilt, O G-d. O G-d of my slavation, my tongue will sing joyously of Your kind justice.
items.text: Ask Hashem in His kindness to accept your teshuvah and thereby rescue you from a harsh penalty, for which you might be marked because of your sins.

items.he: אֲדֹ־נָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ
items.quote: O my L-rd, open my lips so that my mouth may declare Your praise.
items.text: Offer Hashem your promise of sincere gratitude and praise which His forgiveness will enable.

items.title: YERUSHALAYIM
items.he: הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת צִיּוֹן תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָ ִם
items.quote: Establish Tzion at the right time when it pleases You. Build the walls of Yerushalayim.
items.text: Ask Hashem to bring the Geulah and restore Yerushalayim so that sacrificial offerings may once more be brought with the proper devotion and sincerity.

items.he: אָז תַּחְפֹּץ זִבְחֵי צֶדֶק עוֹלָה וְכָלִיל
items.quote: Then You will want the offerings of righteousness, burnt-offering and whole-offering.

52.title: Tragic Talk
52.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: KINDNESS
items.he: חֶסֶד אֵ־ל כָּל הַיּוֹם
items.quote: The kindness of G-d is all day long.
items.text: Hashem’s kindness is always accessible to protect the victims of persecution.

items.title: JUDGMENT
items.he: אֵ־ל יִתָּצְךָ לָנֶצַח יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּחֲךָ מֵאֹהֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים
items.quote: Likewise, G-d will smash you for eternity. He will pluck you out and tear you away from the tent. He will uproot you from the land of life.
items.text: When Hashem’s wrath is invoked by evil behavior, He executes a harsh judgment.

items.title: DECEITFUL TONGUE
items.he: הַוּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁב לְשׁוֹנֶךָ כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה
items.quote: Your tongue plans treachery like a sharpened razor that acts deceitfully.
items.text: Evil talk is like a sharpened razor that cuts into the flesh when the user intended only to shave off the hair. You may fool yourself into thinking that evil talk is harmless, nothing more than words. But it can cut deep and is a great sin.

items.title: LOVING EVIL
items.he: אָהַבְתָּ רָּע מִטּוֹב שֶׁקֶר מִדַּבֵּר צֶדֶק
items.quote: You love evil more than good, falsehood than speaking right.
items.text: Sinful behavior does not just happen. It begans with a sinful frame of mind which tolerates evil and is ultimately attracted to it.

items.he: אָהַבְתָּ כָל דִּבְרֵי בָלַע לְשׁוֹן מִרְמָה
items.quote: You love all devouring words, a tongue of deceit.

items.title: FEAR OF SIN
items.he: וְיִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִירָאוּ
items.quote: The tzadikim will see and fear.
items.text: No one is immune from sin. Even a tzadik should think about the lessons to be learned from the downfall of an evil man.

items.title: MOTIVE OF SIN
items.he: הִנֵּה הַגֶּבֶר לֹא יָשִׂים אֱלֹקִים מָעוּזּוֹ וַיִּבְטַח בְּרֹב עָשְׁרוֹ
items.quote: Look the man who did not make G-d the source of his strength; but he trusted in his abundance of wealth.
items.text: A person who relies on his own wealth instead of the good will of Hashem, will be motivated to act unethically to achieve his objectives.

items.title: MOTIVE OF GOODNESS
items.he: וַאֲנִי כְּזַיִת רַעֲנָן בְּבֵית אֱלֹקִים בָּטַחְתִּי בְחֶסֶד אֱלֹקִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד
items.quote: But I am like an ever-fresh olive tree in the House of G-d. I trust in the kindness of G-d forever and ever.
items.text: Plant your roots in the place where the Torah is studied, for that will inspire you to good deeds.

items.title: HOPE
items.he: אוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲקַוֶּה שִׁמְךָ כִי טוֹב
items.quote: I will forever thank You for [what] You have done. I will hope in Your Name, for it is good.
items.text: Express your intention to continue to thank Hashem for all He has done. By showing your appreciation you will be deserving of hope in the future.

53.title: Exposing Evil
53.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: GUARD YOUR HEART
items.he: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹקִים, הִשְׁחִיתוּ הִתְעִיבוּ עָוֶל אֵין עֹשֵׂה טוֹב
items.quote: The villainous fool says in his heart, ‘There is no G-d.’ They have acted corruptly and committed despicable wrongdoings. There is not one who does good.
items.text: It is not enough to behave properly. You must have a good attitude and emunah in Hashem; otherwise you will end up like the villainous fool.

items.title: STRENGTH OF CHARACTER
items.he: כֻּלּוֹ סָג יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה טוֹב אֵין גַּם אֶחָד
items.quote: But all have become [worthless] like dross. They have gone foul together. There is no doer of good; there is not even one.
items.text: When your generation is being tested, stand up for what you believe in and do the right thing, even if it means going against everyone else.

items.title: RESTORATION
items.he: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשֻׁעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב אֱלֹקִים שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ
items.quote: May Yisrael’s rescue come from Tzion! When Hashem restores the exiles of His people.
items.text: Ask Hashem to bring the Geulah now. May He restore the Jewish people to Tzion and the service of Hashem as in ancient times.”

54.title: Betrayal and Bitachon
54.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.raw: [54:3] KINDNESS. – אֱלֹקִים בְּשִׁמְךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ תְדִינֵנִי – “O G-d, save me for the sake of Your Name. Impose Your judgment for me with Your power.” Ask Hashem to save you through the power of the Name Hashem representing His kindness [י-ה-ו-ה ].

items.title: HEAR MY TEFILLOS
items.he: אֱלֹקִים שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה לְאִמְרֵי פִי
items.quote: O G-d, hear my prayer. Listen to the words of my mouth..
items.text: Ask Hashem to listen to your tefillos whether spoken or unspoken.

items.title: LOYALTY
items.he: הִנֵּה אֱלֹקִים עֹזֵר לִי אֲדֹ־נָי בְּסֹמְכֵי נַפְשִׁי
items.quote: I see G-d is helping me; my L-rd [is helping me] through those who support me.
items.text: Thank Hashem for the loyalty of the people who have helped you in times of difficulty.

items.title: DEVOTION
items.he: בִּנְדָבָה אֶזְבְּחָה לָּךְ אוֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ ה’ כִּי טוֹב
items.quote: I will offer sacrifices to You with devotion. I will give thanks to Your Name, Hashem, for it is good.
items.text: Thank Hashem with sincerity and devotion for the times He saved you.

items.he: כִּי מִכָּל צָרָה הִצִּילָנִי וּבְאֹיְבַי רָאֲתָה עֵינִי
items.quote: For He has rescued me from every trouble. My eye has gazed upon my foes.

55.title: Overcoming Despondency
55.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: LOGIC AND HEART
items.he: הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹקִים תְּפִלָּתִי וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתִי
items.quote: Listen, O G-d, to my tefillah and don’t ignore my [emotional] supplication.
items.text: Ask Hashem to be receptive to your plea, whether it is a carefully reasoned prayer or an emotional supplication.

items.he: הַקְשִׁיבָה לִּי וַעֲנֵנִי אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי וְאָהִימָה
items.quote: Hear me and answer me for I am crying as I pour out my grief and I groan.

items.title: THE PAIN OF HATRED
items.he: כִּי יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן וּבְאַף יִשְׂטְמוּנִי
items.quote: [I am in anguish] for they charge me with sin. They hate me with vehemence.
items.text: It is painful to be hated, even when the enmity is unjustified.

items.title: THE PAIN OF FEAR
items.he: לִבִּי יָחִיל בְּקִרְבִּי וְאֵימוֹת מָוֶת נָפְלוּ עָלָי
items.quote: My heart is convulsed within me and the terrors of death have fallen upon me.
items.text: Help me overcome the emotion of terror.

items.he: יִרְאָה וָרַעַד יָבֹא בִי וַתְּכַסֵּנִי פַּלָּצוּת
items.quote: Fear and shivering fright penetrate me and I am overwhelmed with shaking.

items.title: CONFUSION
items.he: בַּלַּע אֲדֹ־נָי פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם כִּי רָאִיתִי חָמָס וְרִיב בָּעִיר
items.quote: Sabotage [their conspiracy], my L-rd and divide their speech, for I have [already] seen cursing and quarreling [among them] in the city.
items.text: May our enemies be confused and riven by quarrels among themselves.

items.title: BETRAYAL
items.he: וְאַתָּה אֱנוֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּי אַלּוּפִי וּמְיֻדָּעִי
items.quote: But it is you, a man my equal my mentor and my intimate friend.
items.text: Protect me from the betrayal of close friends or family who turn against me.

items.he: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד בְּבֵית אֱלֹקִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָגֶשׁ
items.quote: With whom together we shared sweet counsel. In the house of G-d we would walk in company.

items.title: YESHUAH
items.he: אֲנִי אֶל אֱלֹקִים אֶקְרָא וַה’ יוֹשִׁיעֵנִי
items.quote: As for me, I will to call to G-d and because He is Hashem, He will save me.
items.text: When you are in distress turn to Hashem and pray for a yeshuah. Incorporate your personal plea in every regular tefillah. Pray to Hashem with deep sincerity.

items.he: עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂיחָה וְאֶהֱמֶה וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי
items.quote: Evening, morning, and noon, I supplicate and cry aloud; and He has heard my voice.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל ה’ יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ
items.quote: Cast your burden upon Hashem and He will sustain you.
items.text: No matter how hopeless your situation seems, trust in Hashem to take care of you, for you are always in His hands.

56.title: Count My Tears
56.intro: Listed below are some of the lessons that you can draw from this mizmor, as well as some of the thoughts you might have in mind when you say the words of the mizmor as a tefillah, expressing your devotion to Hashem.

items.title: DIRECT THREAT
items.he: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹקִים כִּי שְׁאָפַנִי אֱנוֹשׁ כָּל הַיּוֹם לֹחֵם יִלְחָצֵנִי
items.quote: Grant me favor, O G-d, a man is eager to devour me. Every day he has been straining to make war against me.
items.text: Turn to Hashem for help when you are in personal danger.

items.raw: [56:3] – שָׁאֲפוּ שׁוֹרְרַי כָּל הַיּוֹם כִּי רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרוֹם – “Every day my watchful foes are eager to devour me for there are many who are striving against me, O Most High.

items.title: BITACHON
items.he: יוֹם אִירָא אֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ אֶבְטָח
